findings.title: No API Interface — Direct Database Access Only
findings.description: The application is a Win32 desktop EXE (Visual Basic 6.0) that communicates directly with a Microsoft Access .mdb file on an SMB file share via ADODB. There is no REST, GraphQL, AsyncAPI, or any programmatic interface. Integration requires direct database access or UI automation.
findings.gap: No API exists. The only integration surface is a Win32 form and a shared Access database file at S:\CRM\sales.mdb.
findings.recommendation: Implement a REST API layer (e.g., .NET Web API or Node.js Express) wrapping customer CRUD operations. Migrate from Access .mdb to a proper database engine.

findings.title: Non-Idempotent Write Operations
findings.description: The sole write operation (cmdSave_Click) performs an INSERT INTO Customers with no idempotency key, no unique constraint on business keys, and no deduplication mechanism. Repeated execution creates duplicate records.
findings.gap: No idempotency keys, no unique business key constraints, no deduplication logic.
findings.recommendation: Add unique constraints on business keys and implement idempotency key support in write operations.

findings.title: No Machine Identity Authentication
findings.description: The application uses a single hardcoded database password (crm2005pw) embedded in source code. No concept of machine identity, service accounts, OAuth 2.0 client credentials, API keys, or mTLS.
findings.gap: No machine identity authentication mechanism. No service account support. No principal attribution.
findings.recommendation: Implement OAuth 2.0 client credentials flow or API key authentication with per-agent identity attribution in audit logs.

findings.title: No Audit Logging
findings.description: No audit logging exists. On Error Resume Next swallows all errors with no logging. CreatedBy/CreatedOn are mutable database fields, not an immutable audit trail.
findings.gap: No immutable audit trail. No logging of authenticated principals. No tamper-evident log storage.
findings.recommendation: Implement immutable audit logging (CloudTrail or equivalent) with S3 object lock and agent identity attribution on every write.

findings.title: No Compensation or Rollback Capability
findings.description: No compensation or rollback mechanism exists. The single INSERT operation is fire-and-forget with On Error Resume Next. No transactions, saga patterns, or undo logic.
findings.gap: No rollback. No compensation. No transaction management. Access database has no transaction isolation.
findings.recommendation: Implement database transactions with rollback. Add saga pattern for multi-step operations.

findings.title: Sensitive Data Fully Exposed — No Scoping or Access Differentiation
findings.description: Stage A: System stores customer PII in Access database. Stage B: B1 — no field filtering, single credential grants full access to all data. B2 — no access differentiation. B3 — no classification.
findings.gap: B1: All data fully exposed via shared credential. B2: No access differentiation mechanism. B3: No data classification.
findings.recommendation: Implement field-level filtering in API responses and role-based access differentiation.

findings.title: No Data Residency Controls
findings.description: Customer PII stored on uncontrolled SMB file share (S:\CRM\sales.mdb). No data residency controls, region configuration, or sovereignty enforcement.
findings.gap: No residency controls. No region configuration. No sovereignty policies.
findings.recommendation: Classify data against applicable regulations. Implement residency controls at infrastructure layer. Use region-local LLM endpoints.

findings.title: No Scoped Permissions
findings.description: Single hardcoded credential grants full read/write access to entire database. No mechanism for scoped permissions or access differentiation.
findings.gap: No authorization model. No scoped permissions. No IAM policies. No role differentiation.
findings.recommendation: Implement RBAC or ABAC authorization model with per-agent scoped permissions in new API layer.

findings.title: No Action-Level Authorization
findings.description: No action-level authorization exists. Any caller with the database password can perform any operation on any record.
findings.gap: No ABAC/RBAC. No action-level checks. No permission matrix.
findings.recommendation: Implement action-level authorization distinguishing read, create, update, and delete operations per agent identity.

findings.title: No Identity Propagation
findings.description: No identity propagation mechanism. Windows USERNAME environment variable captured in CreatedBy field is not an authenticated identity and is trivially spoofable.
findings.gap: No JWT/OAuth token exchange. No on-behalf-of flows. No agent/user identity distinction.
findings.recommendation: Implement identity propagation (OAuth 2.0 on-behalf-of or JWT with subject claim) in new API layer.

findings.title: Hardcoded Credentials in Source Code
findings.description: Database credentials hardcoded as constants in VB6 source code (Private Const DB_PW As String = "crm2005pw"). Password committed to version control in plaintext.
findings.gap: Hardcoded credentials. No secrets management (no Secrets Manager, no Vault). No rotation. Plaintext in repository.
findings.recommendation: Migrate credentials to AWS Secrets Manager with automatic rotation. Remove from git history.

findings.title: No Agent Identity Suspension Capability
findings.description: No agent identity concept. Single shared credential cannot be selectively revoked without breaking all access.
findings.gap: No per-agent identity. No suspension mechanism. No individual revocation.
findings.recommendation: Implement per-agent credentials with individual revocation capability.

findings.title: No Concurrency Controls — Known Data Corruption
findings.description: No concurrency controls exist. Access .mdb on file share has no optimistic locking, no version fields, no ETags. Monthly data corruption from concurrent writes confirmed.
findings.gap: No optimistic locking. No version fields. No conflict resolution. Known corruption.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to database with proper concurrency controls. Implement optimistic locking with version fields.

findings.title: No Blast Radius or Transaction Limits
findings.description: No transaction limits exist. No configurable caps on records modified, operations per session, or business-domain limits. Unlimited INSERT operations possible.
findings.gap: No per-caller transaction limits. No bulk operation caps. No business-domain limits.
findings.recommendation: Implement configurable per-agent transaction limits in new API layer.

findings.title: No Draft/Pending State for Agent Writes
findings.description: No draft or pending state exists. INSERT operations immediately commit records. No intermediate state for human review.
findings.gap: No draft/pending status fields. No approval workflow. No two-step commit. All writes immediate.
findings.recommendation: Add status field with PENDING/APPROVED states to entities. Agent-created records start as PENDING.

findings.title: No Configurable Approval Gates
findings.description: No approval gates exist. All operations execute immediately without configurable approval steps.
findings.gap: No approval API endpoints. No configurable operation-level flags. No HITL mechanism.
findings.recommendation: Implement configurable per-operation approval requirements in new API layer.

findings.title: No PII Redaction Capability
findings.description: No PII redaction capability. No logging infrastructure exists currently, but no controls prevent PII exposure if observability is added. SQL strings contain customer names in memory.
findings.gap: No log scrubbing. No PII masking. No structured logging with field filtering.
findings.recommendation: Implement structured logging with PII redaction from the start in modernized architecture.

findings.title: State Only Accessible via Direct Database File Access
findings.description: Application state stored in Access .mdb only queryable via direct ADODB connections. No API endpoint to query current state.
findings.gap: No GET endpoints. No status query APIs. Direct database file access only.
findings.recommendation: Implement read endpoints in new API layer with proper filtering and pagination.

findings.title: No Input Validation — SQL Injection Vulnerability
findings.description: No input validation. User input (txtName.Text) concatenated directly into SQL string. SQL injection vulnerability. No schema enforcement.
findings.gap: No validation. No parameterized queries. SQL injection via string concatenation.
findings.recommendation: Replace string-concatenated SQL with parameterized queries. Implement input validation with structured error responses.

findings.title: Incomplete Temporal Metadata
findings.description: Only CreatedOn (via Now()) exists. No UpdatedAt field. No timezone normalization. No freshness signaling.
findings.gap: No updated_at. No timezone handling. No freshness signals.
findings.recommendation: Add updated_at timestamps. Store in UTC. Implement freshness signaling in API responses.

findings.title: No Schema Versioning or API Contracts
findings.description: No schema versioning. Schema implicit from INSERT statement only. No migrations, contracts, or breaking change detection.
findings.gap: No schema documentation. No versioning. No migrations. No contract tests.
findings.recommendation: Document schema, implement versioned migrations, add contract testing in CI.

findings.title: No Sandbox/Staging Environment
findings.description: No sandbox or staging environment. Single production environment. Manual EXE deployment.
findings.gap: No staging. No sandbox. No test data. No environment separation.
findings.recommendation: Create staging environment with production-equivalent data shape as part of modernization.

findings.title: Zero Automated Test Coverage
findings.description: No automated tests of any kind. No CI pipeline. Compiled on one developer's machine.
findings.gap: No unit tests. No integration tests. No API tests. No CI.
findings.recommendation: Implement automated API tests in CI as part of modernization. Target critical path coverage.

findings.title: No Encryption at Rest
findings.description: Data stored in unencrypted Access .mdb on SMB file share. Access database password is weak access control, not encryption.
findings.gap: No encryption at rest. No KMS. No disk-level encryption.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to cloud database with KMS encryption at rest (RDS with AWS KMS).

findings.title: No Machine-Readable API Specification
findings.description: No HTTP/RPC surface — machine-readable spec is not applicable. Desktop application with no server component.
findings.gap: No API surface to document.
findings.recommendation: Create OpenAPI specification when API layer is built.

findings.title: No Structured Error Responses
findings.description: No HTTP/RPC surface — structured error responses not applicable. Errors shown via MsgBox dialogs.
findings.gap: No API surface; errors via MsgBox only.
findings.recommendation: Design structured error format when API layer is built.

findings.title: No Event Emission for State Changes
findings.description: No event emission capability. Direct INSERT only. No webhooks, message queues, or CDC pipelines.
findings.gap: No event-driven integration possible.
findings.recommendation: Add event emission (EventBridge/SNS) for state changes in modernized architecture.

findings.title: No Rate Limiting — No API Surface
findings.description: No HTTP/RPC surface — API-layer rate limiting is not applicable. Desktop application accessed via file share.
findings.gap: No API surface to apply rate limits to.
findings.recommendation: Include rate limiting (API Gateway usage plans) when API layer is built.

findings.title: No Distributed Tracing or Structured Logging
findings.description: No HTTP/RPC surface and no request path to trace. No logging of any kind. On Error Resume Next swallows all errors.
findings.gap: No tracing. No structured logging. No correlation IDs.
findings.recommendation: Include OpenTelemetry and structured JSON logging in modernized architecture.

findings.title: No Alerting Infrastructure
findings.description: No HTTP/RPC surface — alerting on API error rates and latency not applicable. No monitoring exists.
findings.gap: No alerting infrastructure.
findings.recommendation: Include CloudWatch alarms and alerting in modernized architecture.

findings.title: No Infrastructure as Code
findings.description: No HTTP/RPC surface and no auth surface — infrastructure governance not applicable. No IaC exists. Manual provisioning only.
findings.gap: No IaC. Manual provisioning.
findings.recommendation: Use Terraform or CDK for all infrastructure in modernized architecture.

findings.title: No CI/CD Pipeline
findings.description: No HTTP/RPC surface — API contract testing not applicable. No CI/CD pipeline exists.
findings.gap: No CI/CD. Compiled on one developer's machine.
findings.recommendation: Implement CI/CD pipeline with contract testing when API layer is built.

findings.title: No Rollback Capability
findings.description: No deployed HTTP/RPC surface — deployment rollback not applicable. Manual EXE copying is the deployment.
findings.gap: No rollback. Manual deployment only.
findings.recommendation: Implement blue/green or canary deployment in modernized architecture.

findings.title: Field Names Reasonably Semantic
findings.description: Field names are reasonably semantic (Customers, Name, CreatedBy, CreatedOn). VB6 Hungarian notation for UI controls (txtName, cmdSave) is interpretable.
findings.gap: No major naming issues. UI controls use Hungarian notation but database fields are clear.
findings.recommendation: Maintain semantic naming in modernized schema.

findings.title: No Data Catalog or Metadata Layer
findings.description: No data catalog or metadata layer. Schema undocumented beyond what is inferred from INSERT statement.
findings.gap: No catalog. No data dictionary. No schema documentation.
findings.recommendation: Implement data catalog as part of modernization.

findings.title: No Data Quality Monitoring — Known Corruption
findings.description: No data quality metrics or monitoring. Known monthly data corruption from concurrent writes.
findings.gap: No quality metrics. No completeness monitoring. Monthly corruption events.
findings.recommendation: Implement data quality monitoring when migrating to new database.

findings.title: No Documented API Interface
findings.description: The application exposes no REST, GraphQL, or AsyncAPI interface. It serves HTML pages via ColdFusion templates over HTTP. Integration would require direct database access or UI automation.
findings.gap: No programmatic API exists. The only integration surface is HTML pages.
findings.recommendation: Implement a REST API layer with JSON responses for document listing, search, and download operations.

findings.title: No Machine-Readable API Specification
findings.description: No OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, GraphQL schema, or machine-readable specification exists.
findings.gap: No machine-readable spec for agent tool generation.
findings.recommendation: Create OpenAPI 3.0 specification concurrent with REST API implementation.

findings.title: No Structured Error Responses
findings.description: No structured error responses. ColdFusion returns default HTML error pages on failure with no error codes or retry guidance.
findings.gap: Agents cannot distinguish retriable from terminal errors.
findings.recommendation: Implement structured JSON error responses with error codes and retryable indicators.

findings.title: No Idempotent Write Operations
findings.description: No idempotency controls exist. SQL queries use string concatenation with no idempotency keys. File uploads write directly to disk with original filenames.
findings.gap: Duplicate agent calls would create duplicate records/files with no deduplication.
findings.recommendation: Add idempotency key support to all write endpoints.

findings.title: HTML-Only Response Format
findings.description: All responses are HTML. No JSON, XML, or structured machine-readable format is returned.
findings.gap: LLMs cannot consume HTML table output directly as structured data.
findings.recommendation: Implement JSON response format when building the REST API layer.

findings.title: No Event Emission for State Changes
findings.description: No event emission capability. No webhooks, SNS/EventBridge/SQS integration, or message queues.
findings.gap: Agents cannot react to document uploads or state changes without polling.
findings.recommendation: Consider EventBridge integration when modernizing.

findings.title: No Rate Limit Documentation or Headers
findings.description: No rate limit documentation or headers. No X-RateLimit-Remaining or Retry-After headers.
findings.gap: Agents cannot self-throttle based on system feedback.
findings.recommendation: Implement rate limit headers when deploying API Gateway.

findings.title: No Machine Identity Authentication
findings.description: Session-based authentication only. No OAuth2, API keys, mTLS, or service account support. The datasource password is 'cfadmin'.
findings.gap: No machine identity authentication. Cannot distinguish machine callers from human users.
findings.recommendation: Implement OAuth2 client credentials or API key authentication with principal attribution.

findings.title: No Scoped Permissions
findings.description: Binary authorization model — users are either authenticated or not. No role differentiation or permission scoping.
findings.gap: Cannot grant an agent read-only access to specific resources without inheriting full access.
findings.recommendation: Implement RBAC with role-per-agent-capability.

findings.title: No Action-Level Authorization
findings.description: No action-level authorization. Single session check does not distinguish between read and write operations.
findings.gap: Cannot enforce read-only access for an agent within the same resource type.
findings.recommendation: Implement fine-grained RBAC or ABAC with action-level checks.

findings.title: No Identity Propagation
findings.description: No identity propagation. ColdFusion session variables only. No JWT, OAuth token exchange, or on-behalf-of flows.
findings.gap: Cannot distinguish agent-as-self from agent-on-behalf-of-user.
findings.recommendation: Implement OAuth2 with token exchange supporting on-behalf-of flows.

findings.title: Hardcoded Credentials
findings.description: Credentials embedded in ColdFusion Administrator. README documents password as 'cfadmin'. No secrets management or rotation.
findings.gap: Hardcoded credentials with no rotation. Known password documented in source control.
findings.recommendation: Immediately rotate password and migrate to AWS Secrets Manager with automatic rotation.

findings.title: No Immutable Audit Logging
findings.description: No audit logging exists. No CloudTrail, no application-level audit logs, no immutable log storage.
findings.gap: No audit trail for any operations. Cannot prove compliance or conduct forensics.
findings.recommendation: Implement immutable audit logging with principal attribution (CloudTrail + S3 Object Lock).

findings.title: No Agent Identity Suspension
findings.description: No mechanism to suspend or revoke individual agent identities. Session-based system has no revocable machine identities.
findings.gap: Cannot isolate a misbehaving agent without shutting down the entire application.
findings.recommendation: Implement revocable API keys or OAuth2 client credentials with individual disable capability.

findings.title: No Compensation or Rollback
findings.description: No compensation or rollback mechanism. Direct SQL with no transaction management. SQL injection compounds the issue.
findings.gap: Failed multi-step operations leave system in partial state with no recovery mechanism.
findings.recommendation: Implement database transactions with rollback and saga pattern for multi-step operations.

findings.title: No Machine-Readable Queryable State
findings.description: Document listing available via HTML only. No API endpoints return current resource state in machine-readable format.
findings.gap: Cannot programmatically inspect state before taking action.
findings.recommendation: Implement JSON GET endpoints for document state and collection queries.

findings.title: No Concurrency Controls
findings.description: No concurrency controls. No optimistic locking, version fields, ETags, or conditional writes.
findings.gap: Concurrent agent writes would create race conditions and data corruption.
findings.recommendation: Add version fields and implement optimistic locking on all write operations.

findings.title: No Rate Limiting
findings.description: No rate limiting at any layer. No API Gateway, WAF, or application-level throttling middleware.
findings.gap: No protection against agent traffic storms or runaway loops on single-instance server.
findings.recommendation: Deploy API Gateway with usage plans and throttling configuration.

findings.title: No Blast Radius or Transaction Limits
findings.description: No transaction limits. No per-session operation caps or business-domain constraints.
findings.gap: Agent errors have unlimited blast radius — unbounded records affected per operation.
findings.recommendation: Implement configurable per-caller transaction limits.

findings.title: No Draft/Pending State
findings.description: No draft or pending state concept. All write operations are immediately committed with no reviewable intermediate state.
findings.gap: No mechanism for agent to propose changes for human review before commitment.
findings.recommendation: Add status field (DRAFT/PENDING/PUBLISHED) with explicit approval step.

findings.title: No Configurable Approval Gates
findings.description: No configurable approval gates. All operations execute immediately without human oversight.
findings.gap: Cannot configure specific operations to require human approval before execution.
findings.recommendation: Implement configurable approval gates for high-risk operations.

findings.title: No Sandbox/Staging Environment
findings.description: No sandbox or staging environment. Single production EC2 instance with manual file copy deployment.
findings.gap: No safe environment to test agent behavior before production.
findings.recommendation: Create containerized staging environment with production-equivalent data shape.

findings.title: Sensitive Data Exposed Without Scoping
findings.description: System stores user-specific data (userid, fullname, uploaded_by) and corporate documents. SQL queries return all columns without field filtering. No access differentiation.
findings.gap: B1: All fields exposed without filtering. B2: No access control differentiation. B3: No formal classification.
findings.recommendation: Implement field-level response filtering and role-based data access differentiation.

findings.title: No Data Residency Controls
findings.description: No data residency controls. Corporate documents stored on local D: drive with no compliance framework or region-specific controls.
findings.gap: No safeguards against cross-jurisdiction data movement when agent transmits to LLM provider.
findings.recommendation: Classify data for residency requirements and implement region-locked storage.

findings.title: No Pagination or Selective Query
findings.description: No pagination. SQL returns all matching documents without LIMIT or OFFSET. Result sets are unbounded.
findings.gap: Agents would receive unbounded result sets exhausting LLM context windows.
findings.recommendation: Implement cursor-based pagination with configurable page size.

findings.title: No Input Validation — SQL Injection Vulnerable
findings.description: No input validation. url.q parameter directly concatenated into SQL (SQL injection). url.id used without type checking. No parameterized queries or sanitization.
findings.gap: All inputs accepted without validation. SQL injection and path traversal possible.
findings.recommendation: Replace all SQL string concatenation with cfqueryparam immediately. Implement comprehensive input validation.

findings.title: Partial Temporal Metadata, No Freshness Signaling
findings.description: Partial temporal metadata — uploaded_on field exists. No timezone normalization, no Cache-Control headers, no freshness indicators.
findings.gap: Limited temporal metadata with no mechanism to signal data freshness to agents.
findings.recommendation: Normalize timestamps to UTC, add updated_at field, implement Cache-Control headers.

findings.title: No PII Redaction in Logs
findings.description: No PII redaction. User data (session.fullname, uploaded_by) output directly. ColdFusion default logging may capture user data unmasked.
findings.gap: PII potentially captured in logs without masking.
findings.recommendation: Implement PII masking in all log outputs and configure log retention with access controls.

findings.title: No Data Quality Awareness
findings.description: No data quality metrics, completeness scores, or freshness SLAs exist.
findings.gap: Cannot assess data reliability before agent action.
findings.recommendation: Implement basic data quality monitoring for the documents table.

findings.title: No Schema Versioning or API Contracts
findings.description: No schema versioning, API contracts, or breaking change detection. No versioned URLs, changelog, or database migrations.
findings.gap: No mechanism to detect or communicate breaking changes to agent tool bindings.
findings.recommendation: Implement API versioning from day one with contract testing in CI.

findings.title: No Data Catalog or Metadata Layer
findings.description: No data catalog, metadata layer, or schema documentation describing what data the system holds.
findings.gap: Agent tool builders must reverse-engineer the data model from source code.
findings.recommendation: Document the data model and consider AWS Glue Data Catalog integration.

findings.title: No Distributed Tracing or Structured Logging
findings.description: No distributed tracing (X-Ray, OpenTelemetry). No structured logging. No correlation IDs.
findings.gap: Cannot debug agent-initiated requests. No traceability.
findings.recommendation: Implement OpenTelemetry/X-Ray with structured JSON logging and request correlation IDs.

findings.title: No Alerting on Error Rates or Latency
findings.description: No alerting configured. No CloudWatch alarms, monitoring thresholds, or anomaly detection.
findings.gap: System degradation undetectable until agent failures cascade.
findings.recommendation: Deploy CloudWatch alarms on HTTP 5xx rates and p95 latency.

findings.title: No Infrastructure as Code
findings.description: No IaC. Manual deployment via network file copy. No Terraform, CloudFormation, or CDK. No peer review. No drift detection.
findings.gap: No IaC governance for agent-facing infrastructure.
findings.recommendation: Define all infrastructure in Terraform/CDK with PR-based review.

findings.title: No CI/CD Pipeline
findings.description: No CI/CD pipeline. Manual file copy deployment. No automated testing or contract validation.
findings.gap: API breaking changes cannot be caught before production.
findings.recommendation: Implement CI/CD pipeline with automated tests and API contract validation.

findings.title: No Rollback Capability
findings.description: No rollback. Manual file copy with no versioning, blue/green, or canary deployments.
findings.gap: Cannot quickly rollback agent-breaking deployments.
findings.recommendation: Implement automated deployment with rollback capability (CodeDeploy or containers).

findings.title: No API Test Coverage
findings.description: No automated tests. No test files, framework, or directories. Zero test coverage.
findings.gap: No tests validating API behavior, input handling, or error responses.
findings.recommendation: Implement automated test suite covering API endpoints and error handling.

findings.title: No Encryption at Rest
findings.description: No encryption at rest. Local disk storage and SQL Server 2005 (no TDE support). No KMS.
findings.gap: Data at rest unencrypted. Breach exposes all documents and database contents.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to S3 with KMS encryption and RDS with encryption enabled.

findings.title: No Documented API Interface
findings.description: The application exposes Django views serving HTML responses via raw SQL. No REST, GraphQL, or AsyncAPI interface exists. Integration requires reverse-engineering HTML views or direct database access.
findings.gap: No API layer exists. Views return HTML via render_to_response and raw HttpResponse. No JSON endpoints, no API documentation.
findings.recommendation: Create a REST API layer (Django REST Framework or FastAPI) that exposes ticket operations as JSON endpoints with documented contracts. Requires Python/Django upgrade first.

findings.title: No Machine-Readable API Specification
findings.description: No OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, GraphQL schema, or machine-readable API specification exists in the repository.
findings.gap: Agent tool generation requires fully manual authoring with no spec to validate against.
findings.recommendation: Create an OpenAPI specification documenting all endpoints. Preferably auto-generated from API framework annotations.

findings.title: No Structured Error Responses
findings.description: No structured error responses. DEBUG = True returns full HTML stack traces. No error codes, no machine-readable error format.
findings.gap: Agents cannot distinguish retriable from terminal errors. No structured error format exists.
findings.recommendation: Implement consistent JSON error response format with error code, message, and retryable indicator across all endpoints.

findings.title: No Idempotent Write Operations
findings.description: No idempotency mechanisms exist. No idempotency keys, no unique constraint enforcement on business keys. Django admin provides write operations without idempotency guarantees.
findings.gap: Write operations vulnerable to duplication on agent retry. No idempotency key support.
findings.recommendation: Implement idempotency keys on all write endpoints once a proper API layer exists.

findings.title: HTML Response Format
findings.description: API responses are HTML — render_to_response templates and raw HTML strings. No JSON serialization or structured response format.
findings.gap: LLMs cannot consume HTML responses effectively. Any agent integration requires HTML-to-data parsing or response format rewrite.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to JSON responses for all agent-facing endpoints.

findings.title: No Event Emission for State Changes
findings.description: No event emission capability. No webhooks, no SNS/EventBridge/SQS integration, no Kafka, no CDC pipelines.
findings.gap: Agents cannot react to ticket state changes without polling.
findings.recommendation: Implement SNS/EventBridge notifications on ticket status changes for event-driven agent integration.

findings.title: No Rate Limit Documentation or Headers
findings.description: No rate limit documentation and no rate limit response headers. No API Gateway usage plans.
findings.gap: Agents cannot self-throttle. Undocumented limits cause unpredictable failures.
findings.recommendation: Document rate limits and implement rate limit response headers once a proper API layer exists.

findings.title: No Machine Identity Authentication
findings.description: Session-based Django auth only. No OAuth2 client credentials, no API keys with principal attribution, no mTLS, no service accounts.
findings.gap: Agents cannot authenticate without human credentials (username/password session login).
findings.recommendation: Implement OAuth2 client credentials flow or API key authentication with per-agent principal attribution.

findings.title: No Scoped Permissions
findings.description: Django built-in auth provides only basic user/superuser differentiation. No fine-grained RBAC, no per-resource permission scoping.
findings.gap: No mechanism to grant an agent read-only access to specific resources without inheriting broader privileges.
findings.recommendation: Implement permission framework with per-resource scoping or deploy API Gateway with resource-level policies.

findings.title: No Action-Level Authorization
findings.description: No action-level authorization. Views perform no permission checks — any authenticated user can execute any operation.
findings.gap: Cannot enforce read-only vs write access per resource type for agents.
findings.recommendation: Add action-level permission checks to all views/endpoints.

findings.title: No Identity Propagation
findings.description: No identity propagation mechanism. No JWT parsing, no OAuth2 on-behalf-of flows, no token exchange.
findings.gap: Cannot distinguish agent-as-self from agent-on-behalf-of-user.
findings.recommendation: Implement JWT-based identity propagation with distinct flows for service-to-service and user-delegated calls.

findings.title: Hardcoded Credentials in Source Code
findings.description: SECRET_KEY and database password are hardcoded in settings.py committed to git. No secrets management system, no rotation.
findings.gap: Credentials in source code are exposed to anyone with repository access and persist in git history.
findings.recommendation: Remove all hardcoded credentials. Migrate to AWS Secrets Manager with rotation policies.

findings.title: No Immutable Audit Logging
findings.description: No audit logging exists. No CloudTrail, no application-level audit trail, no log storage configuration. Only a debug print statement.
findings.gap: No tamper-evident audit trail for agent actions. No principal logging for any operation.
findings.recommendation: Implement structured audit logging with principal attribution, stored in CloudTrail or equivalent with object lock.

findings.title: No Agent Identity Suspension Mechanism
findings.description: No mechanism to suspend or revoke individual agent identities. Session-based auth only with no key management.

findings.title: No Draft/Pending State
findings.description: No draft or pending state concept. Orders immediately committed via INSERT. No mechanism for agent-proposed changes to await human approval.
findings.gap: All writes immediately committed. No reviewable intermediate state.
findings.recommendation: Add PENDING status to orders for human review before confirmation.

findings.title: No Configurable Approval Gates
findings.description: No approval gates. All operations execute immediately with no configurable human approval step.
findings.gap: Cannot configure human approval for high-risk agent operations.
findings.recommendation: Implement configurable approval gates based on order value thresholds.

findings.title: No Sandbox/Staging Environment
findings.description: No sandbox or staging environment. No docker-compose, no environment configs, no seed data. First agent bugs would manifest in production.
findings.gap: No safe environment for agent testing.
findings.recommendation: Create staging environment with anonymized partner data for agent testing.

findings.title: Sensitive Data Exposed in Error Responses
findings.description: Financial purchase order data stored. Error responses return raw exception messages which may include SQL statements containing partner data and database details. No access control differentiation.
findings.gap: B1: Error responses expose raw DB details. B2: No access differentiation. B3: No formal classification.
findings.recommendation: Sanitize error responses. Implement access control differentiation. Document data classification.

findings.title: No Data Residency Controls
findings.description: Financial purchase order data stored in Oracle at hardcoded IP with no residency controls, no regional restrictions, no encryption in transit, no compliance documentation.
findings.gap: No data residency controls or documentation for financial data. No technical safeguards preventing cross-region data transmission.
findings.recommendation: Document data residency requirements. Implement technical controls for jurisdictional boundaries.

findings.title: No Input Validation — XXE and SQL Injection
findings.description: Zero input validation. XML parsed with no XXE protection (external entities allowed). Parsed values concatenated into SQL strings creating SQL injection vulnerability. No sanitization, no schema validation.
findings.gap: No input validation. Critical vulnerabilities: XXE and SQL injection.
findings.recommendation: Disable external entities in DocumentBuilderFactory. Use PreparedStatement. Add XML schema validation.

findings.title: No Temporal Metadata
findings.description: INSERT stores only partner_id, po_number, amount. No created_at, updated_at, or event_time fields. No timezone handling. No freshness headers.
findings.gap: No temporal metadata. Agent cannot reason about data freshness.
findings.recommendation: Add created_at (UTC) and updated_at columns to partner_orders table.

findings.title: PII Exposed in Error Responses
findings.description: Error responses return raw exception text which may contain partner data from failed SQL statements. No PII redaction or sanitization.
findings.gap: Raw exception messages may contain partner financial data. No PII redaction.
findings.recommendation: Replace raw exceptions with generic error codes. Implement log scrubbing if logging is added.

findings.title: No Data Quality Awareness
findings.description: No data quality metrics, dashboards, or monitoring for the partner_orders table.
findings.gap: No data quality awareness for agent-consumed data.
findings.recommendation: Implement basic data quality monitoring (duplicate detection, null field rates).

findings.title: No Schema Versioning
findings.description: WSDL has no versioning. No changelog, no breaking change detection. Hand-maintained and drifts from implementation.
findings.gap: No schema versioning or breaking change detection. Agent tool bindings break silently.
findings.recommendation: Implement API versioning with breaking change detection in CI.

findings.title: Minor Field Name Abbreviations
findings.description: Field names mostly readable (partnerId, poNumber, amount). The parameter 'poXml' requires domain knowledge (PO = Purchase Order, content is raw XML).
findings.gap: Minor: poXml abbreviation not fully self-documenting.
findings.recommendation: Expand abbreviated names when modernizing (e.g., purchaseOrderPayload).

findings.title: No Data Catalog
findings.description: No data catalog or metadata layer describing what data the system holds.
findings.gap: No self-service discovery for tool builders.
findings.recommendation: Document data model. Consider AWS Glue Data Catalog when modernizing.

findings.title: No Tracing or Structured Logging
findings.description: Zero observability. No X-Ray, no OpenTelemetry, no structured logging, no correlation IDs. Agent-initiated failures completely opaque.
findings.gap: No tracing, no structured logging. Impossible to debug agent requests.
findings.recommendation: Implement structured JSON logging with correlation IDs and OpenTelemetry SDK.

findings.title: No Alerting Configuration
findings.description: No CloudWatch alarms, no anomaly detection, no PagerDuty/OpsGenie integration. Service degradation invisible.
findings.gap: Cannot detect agent-caused service degradation.
findings.recommendation: Implement CloudWatch alarms for error rate and latency.

findings.title: No Infrastructure as Code
findings.description: No IaC exists. Manual deployment on JBoss 5.1/RHEL 6. No peer review of infrastructure changes. No drift detection.
findings.gap: Agent-facing infrastructure entirely manually managed.
findings.recommendation: Define infrastructure as code (Terraform or CDK).

findings.title: No CI/CD Pipeline
findings.description: No CI/CD. Manual Ant builds. No contract tests, no automated testing.
findings.gap: No automated contract testing. API changes deploy without validation.
findings.recommendation: Implement CI/CD with contract testing.

findings.title: No Rollback Capability
findings.description: No deployment automation or rollback. Manual WAR deployment on JBoss 5.1.
findings.gap: No automated rollback. Broken deployments require manual intervention.
findings.recommendation: Implement automated deployment with rollback capability.

findings.title: Zero Test Coverage
findings.description: No automated tests. README confirms: 'No tests; partner onboarding is a manual SOAP-UI session.'
findings.gap: Zero test coverage. No API test validation.
findings.recommendation: Implement automated API test suite covering valid submissions, duplicates, invalid XML, and error responses.

findings.title: No Encryption at Rest
findings.description: No encryption configuration visible. Plain JDBC connection. No KMS, no TDE settings.
findings.gap: No evidence of encryption at rest for partner financial data.
findings.recommendation: Enable encryption at rest (Oracle TDE or migrate to RDS with KMS).

findings.title: No API Interface — Batch File Exchange Only
findings.description: The application exposes no REST, GraphQL, or AsyncAPI interface. All integration is via fixed-width flat files transferred over plaintext FTP between the z/OS mainframe and an EC2 gateway.
findings.gap: No machine-callable API exists. Integration requires direct file-system access to mainframe datasets or FTP file pickup on the EC2 gateway.
findings.recommendation: Design a REST API wrapper exposing payroll operations as documented endpoints with OpenAPI specification.

findings.title: No Idempotency Controls on Write Operations
findings.description: The batch payroll process writes output sequentially with no idempotency controls. Re-execution produces duplicate output via new GDG generation.
findings.gap: No idempotency keys, no deduplication checks, no conditional write logic.
findings.recommendation: Add a pay-period/cycle-number check to prevent duplicate execution for the same pay period.

findings.title: No Machine Identity Authentication
findings.description: No machine identity authentication exists. The only credential is a hardcoded plaintext FTP username/password in JCL with no caller attribution.
findings.gap: No mechanism for an agent to authenticate with a unique, attributable machine identity.
findings.recommendation: Deploy centralized identity provider with per-agent service accounts. Replace FTP with SFTP using IAM-attributed credentials.

findings.title: No Immutable Audit Logging
findings.description: No audit logging exists. No CloudTrail, no immutable log storage, no principal attribution for write operations.
findings.gap: Write operations leave no tamper-evident audit trail. Cannot prove compliance or conduct forensics.
findings.recommendation: Enable CloudTrail for EC2 gateway. Implement structured audit logging with caller identity. Store logs in S3 with Object Lock.

findings.title: No Compensation or Rollback Capability
findings.description: No compensation or rollback capability exists. Sequential batch processing with no checkpoint/restart logic.
findings.gap: No saga pattern, no compensating transactions, no undo endpoints, no checkpoint/restart.
findings.recommendation: Implement checkpoint/restart logic and multi-step compensation for the batch workflow.

findings.title: Sensitive Data Unscoped in Agent-Facing Output
findings.description: System processes SSNs and bank accounts. All sensitive data output unscoped in flat files. No access control differentiation.
findings.gap: B1: Sensitive fields in output without filtering. B2: No access differentiation. B3: No classification metadata.
findings.recommendation: Implement field-level filtering. Create separately-authorized endpoints for sensitive data access.

findings.title: No Data Residency Controls — Plaintext FTP of PII
findings.description: SSNs and bank accounts transmitted via plaintext FTP to EC2 with no encryption in transit, no residency controls, no sovereignty policies.
findings.gap: No data residency enforcement, no encryption in transit, no cross-region movement controls.
findings.recommendation: Replace FTP with SFTP or AWS Transfer Family. Implement region-pinning controls and data classification policies.

findings.title: No Scoped Permissions Model
findings.description: No authorization model supports scoped permissions. Single shared FTP credential grants unrestricted access.
findings.gap: No mechanism to scope agent permissions to specific resources or actions.
findings.recommendation: Implement IAM roles with least-privilege policies for any agent-facing surface.

findings.title: No Action-Level Authorization
findings.description: No action-level authorization exists. No differentiation between read/write/delete permissions.
findings.gap: No ABAC, no fine-grained RBAC, no permission matrices.
findings.recommendation: Implement action-level authorization when building the API surface.

findings.title: No Identity Propagation or Delegation
findings.description: No identity propagation. No JWT, no OAuth flows, no caller context. Cannot distinguish agent-as-self from agent-on-behalf-of-user.
findings.gap: No mechanism to propagate caller identity through operations.
findings.recommendation: Design token-based identity propagation into the API modernization plan.

findings.title: Hardcoded Plaintext Credentials
findings.description: FTP credentials hardcoded in plaintext in JCL: username payroll, password PayR0ll2003!. No secrets management, no rotation.
findings.gap: Credentials embedded in source code. No Secrets Manager, no Vault, no rotation.
findings.recommendation: Migrate credentials to AWS Secrets Manager. Replace FTP with SFTP using IAM-based authentication.

findings.title: No Agent Identity Suspension Mechanism
findings.description: No mechanism to suspend individual agent identities. Single shared credential with no per-agent revocation.
findings.gap: Cannot isolate a misbehaving agent without disrupting all consumers.
findings.recommendation: Implement per-agent identities with individual revocation capability.

findings.title: No Concurrency Controls
findings.description: No concurrency controls. Sequential file access with no locking. Concurrent execution produces duplicated/corrupted results.
findings.gap: No optimistic locking, no ETags, no version fields, no conflict detection.
findings.recommendation: Implement mutex/lock mechanism. Add optimistic locking in modernized API.

findings.title: No Circuit Breakers or Resilience Patterns
findings.description: No circuit breakers, retry logic, or timeout configurations. FTP transfer has no timeout or retry on failure.
findings.gap: External dependency failure causes unhandled hang or crash.
findings.recommendation: Add timeout and retry logic for FTP transfer. Implement health-check validation before transfer.

findings.title: No Blast Radius or Transaction Limits
findings.description: No configurable limits on operations. Batch processes ALL employee records unconditionally with no maximum count or spend limits.
findings.gap: No per-agent transaction limits, no maximum records per run, no configurable blast radius.
findings.recommendation: Add configurable record count limits and dry-run mode for agent-initiated executions.

findings.title: No PII Redaction in Logs or Diagnostic Output
findings.description: No PII redaction capability. SSNs and bank accounts in working storage exposed in abend dumps. No log scrubbing or masking.
findings.gap: No log scrubbing, no PII masking. System abends expose PII in diagnostic output.
findings.recommendation: Implement PII masking in all logging and error output when building modernized interface.

findings.title: No Draft/Pending State for Write Operations
findings.description: No draft or pending state. Batch runs to completion immediately with no human review step.
findings.gap: All write operations immediately committed. No reviewable intermediate state.
findings.recommendation: Introduce two-phase execution: preview/summary for review, then commit after approval.

findings.title: No Configurable Approval Gates
findings.description: No configurable approval gates. CA-7 triggers automatically with no human confirmation required.
findings.gap: No approval mechanism for high-risk operations.
findings.recommendation: Add configurable approval gate for agent-initiated payroll runs using Step Functions with human approval task.

findings.title: No Async Support for Long-Running Batch (5-7 Hours)
findings.description: 5-7 hour batch with no async patterns — no job submission API, no polling, no callbacks.
findings.gap: No asynchronous operation support for a long-running process.
findings.recommendation: Implement job submission with status polling endpoint. Consider Step Functions for batch lifecycle.

findings.title: No Queryable State Interface
findings.description: No queryable interface. Employee and payroll state locked in DB2 and z/OS datasets with no API access.
findings.gap: Agent cannot inspect state before taking action.
findings.recommendation: Build read-only API for querying employee payroll state.

findings.title: No Input Validation or Schema Enforcement
findings.description: No input validation at API boundary. COBOL reads fixed-format records without validation. Malformed records processed silently.
findings.gap: No validation, no schema enforcement, no structured error responses for invalid input.
findings.recommendation: Implement request validation with structured error responses in the new API. Add pre-execution data quality checks.

findings.title: No Temporal Metadata in Output
findings.description: No timestamps in output records. No freshness signals. Agent cannot determine data currency.
findings.gap: No temporal metadata, no freshness indicators, no timezone handling.
findings.recommendation: Add processing timestamps and pay period dates to all output.

findings.title: No Schema Versioning or API Contracts
findings.description: No schema versioning. Fixed-width format defined implicitly by COBOL with no formal schema, no versioning, no changelog.
findings.gap: No schema documentation, no versioning, no breaking change detection.
findings.recommendation: Document record layout formally. Add version identifier. Implement contract tests.

findings.title: No Sandbox/Staging Environment
findings.description: No dedicated sandbox. Changes validated in shared QA region only. No isolation for agent testing.
findings.gap: No isolated test environment for agent behavior validation.
findings.recommendation: Establish dedicated sandbox with synthetic payroll data (no real PII).

findings.title: Zero Automated Test Coverage
findings.description: No automated tests. README states 'No automated tests.' No test files, no CI pipeline.
findings.gap: Zero test coverage. No regression detection.
findings.recommendation: Create test baseline with golden file comparisons. Build automated tests.

findings.title: No Encryption at Rest
findings.description: No encryption at rest. DB2 v10 (end of support), z/OS datasets, and EC2 files store sensitive data unencrypted.
findings.gap: Sensitive data (SSN, bank accounts) stored without encryption. No KMS.
findings.recommendation: Encrypt data at rest: upgrade DB2, enable z/OS dataset encryption, ensure EC2 EBS uses KMS.

findings.title: No Distributed Tracing or Structured Logging
findings.description: No tracing or structured logging. Only unstructured JCL SYSOUT. No trace IDs, no correlation IDs.
findings.gap: Cannot reconstruct batch execution from logs.
findings.recommendation: Implement OpenTelemetry tracing and structured JSON logging in modernized system.

findings.title: No Machine-Readable API Specification
findings.description: No HTTP/RPC surface — machine-readable spec is not applicable. System operates via batch file exchange.
findings.gap: No API surface exists to describe with a machine-readable spec.
findings.recommendation: Generate OpenAPI spec as part of the API modernization effort.

findings.title: No Structured Error Responses
findings.description: No HTTP/RPC surface — structured error responses are not applicable. Batch signals failure via JCL return codes.
findings.gap: No API error responses exist.
findings.recommendation: Design structured error format as part of API modernization.

findings.title: Fixed-Width Flat File Response Format
findings.description: Output is fixed-width 120-byte flat file records requiring positional parsing with no self-describing schema.
findings.gap: Non-standard format not directly consumable by agents or LLMs.
findings.recommendation: Implement JSON serialization in the modernized API layer.

findings.title: No Event Emission Capability
findings.description: No event emission. No webhooks, no SNS/EventBridge, no Kafka. State changes not signaled.
findings.gap: State changes invisible to downstream consumers.
findings.recommendation: Publish events to EventBridge for payroll completion when modernizing.

findings.title: No API-Layer Rate Limiting
findings.description: No HTTP/RPC surface — API-layer rate limiting is not applicable. Batch scheduled by CA-7.
findings.gap: No API surface to apply rate limiting.
findings.recommendation: Include API Gateway throttling when building agent-facing interface.

findings.title: No Alerting Configuration
findings.description: No HTTP/RPC surface — alerting on API error rates is not applicable. No CloudWatch alarms exist.
findings.gap: No alerting for batch failures or performance degradation.
findings.recommendation: Configure alerting when building the API surface.

findings.title: No Infrastructure as Code
findings.description: No HTTP/RPC and no auth surface — IaC governance for agent-facing surface not applicable. No IaC exists.
findings.gap: No IaC. Infrastructure managed manually.
findings.recommendation: Define infrastructure as code when building agent-facing components.

findings.title: No CI/CD Pipeline
findings.description: No HTTP/RPC surface — API contract testing not applicable. No CI/CD pipeline exists.
findings.gap: No automated build or deployment process.
findings.recommendation: Establish CI/CD pipeline with contract tests as part of modernization.

findings.title: No Deployment Rollback Capability
findings.description: No HTTP/RPC surface — deployment rollback not applicable. No deployment pipeline. Manual mainframe recompilation required.
findings.gap: No automated rollback mechanism.
findings.recommendation: Include rollback capability in modernization architecture.

findings.title: No Data Quality Metrics
findings.description: No data quality metrics or monitoring. Tax tables updated manually with no completeness tracking.
findings.gap: No data quality awareness. Stale data processed silently.
findings.recommendation: Implement data quality checks before batch execution.

findings.title: Legacy Abbreviated Field Names
findings.description: Field names use abbreviated mainframe conventions: EMP-RATE, WS-FICA, EMP-SSN. Partially interpretable but require domain knowledge.
findings.gap: No data dictionary mapping legacy codes to semantic names.
findings.recommendation: Create data dictionary for agent tool definitions.

findings.title: No Data Catalog or Metadata Layer
findings.description: No data catalog. Only implicit schema in COBOL FD section serves as documentation.
findings.gap: No metadata layer describing data semantics.
findings.recommendation: Create metadata catalog. Consider AWS Glue Data Catalog for modernized layer.

findings.title: No structured API interface — CGI returns HTML only
findings.description: The application exposes an HTTP CGI endpoint (/cgi-bin/pricing.cgi?sku=X&qty=Y) returning unstructured HTML. Agent integration requires HTML parsing — effectively UI automation.
findings.gap: No REST API, no structured responses. Agent integration requires scraping.
findings.recommendation: Add a JSON response mode (Accept: application/json or format=json query parameter) returning structured JSON.

findings.title: No machine identity authentication — endpoint completely open
findings.description: The CGI endpoint has no authentication mechanism. No API keys, no OAuth, no mTLS. Any network-reachable client can call the endpoint without identification.
findings.gap: No machine identity authentication. Cannot attribute requests to a specific agent principal.
findings.recommendation: Deploy API Gateway with API key or OAuth2 client credentials authentication with principal attribution in audit logs.

findings.title: No scoped permissions — all callers have identical access
findings.description: No authorization model exists. The endpoint is completely open — all callers have identical unrestricted access.
findings.gap: No RBAC, no IAM policies, no API key scoping. Cannot differentiate access levels.
findings.recommendation: Introduce API Gateway with usage plans that scope per-caller access.

findings.title: No action-level authorization framework
findings.description: No action-level authorization exists. No ABAC, no RBAC, no permission checks of any kind.
findings.gap: No framework to enforce fine-grained permissions.
findings.recommendation: Implement alongside AUTH-Q2 — API Gateway resource policies can enforce action-level controls.

findings.title: No audit logging — requests are unattributable
findings.description: No audit logging exists. The CGI binary writes no logs. No immutable log storage, no principal attribution, no log retention configuration.
findings.gap: No CloudTrail, no structured access logs, no immutable log storage.
findings.recommendation: Configure Apache access log forwarding to CloudWatch Logs with retention policy. Route logs to S3 with Object Lock.

findings.title: No rate limiting at any layer
findings.description: No rate limiting exists. The CGI endpoint accepts unlimited requests. No API Gateway throttling, no WAF rules, no application-level rate limiting.
findings.gap: No rate limiting at the API layer. A runaway agent loop could overwhelm the service.
findings.recommendation: Deploy API Gateway or Ingress controller with rate limiting.

findings.title: No machine-readable API specification
findings.description: No OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, GraphQL schema, or Smithy model exists. Agent tool generation requires manual work.
findings.gap: No machine-readable spec to auto-generate agent tool definitions.
findings.recommendation: Create an OpenAPI 3.0 specification documenting the pricing endpoint.

findings.title: No structured error responses — all requests return HTTP 200
findings.description: Always returns HTTP 200 with HTML. No error codes, no structured error bodies. If SKU is not found, returns $0.00 — indistinguishable from a free item.
findings.gap: Agents cannot distinguish error conditions from success.
findings.recommendation: Implement structured JSON errors with appropriate HTTP status codes.

findings.title: No input validation — buffer overflow vulnerabilities
findings.description: No input validation. Uses strcpy without bounds checking on user-controlled QUERY_STRING. Buffer overflow possible. No structured validation error responses.
findings.gap: Malformed agent input can crash the process or corrupt memory.
findings.recommendation: Replace strcpy with strncpy or std::string. Add input validation with structured error responses.

findings.title: No schema versioning or API contracts
findings.description: No schema versioning, no API contracts, no changelog, no breaking change detection. No version identifier in URL or response.
findings.gap: Changes to the endpoint silently break consumers.
findings.recommendation: Introduce API versioning and OpenAPI spec with CI validation.

findings.title: No distributed tracing or structured logging
findings.description: No tracing (no X-Ray, no OpenTelemetry). No structured logging. No correlation IDs. Agent-initiated requests are completely opaque.
findings.gap: Zero observability into request processing. Cannot debug agent-initiated failures.
findings.recommendation: Add structured JSON logging and OpenTelemetry instrumentation.

findings.title: No alerting on error rates or latency
findings.description: No alerting configuration. No CloudWatch alarms, no Prometheus alerts. Service degradation affecting agents would go undetected.
findings.gap: No alerting thresholds for the pricing endpoint.
findings.recommendation: Deploy Prometheus with ServiceMonitor and alerting rules for HTTP 5xx and P99 latency.

findings.title: Partial IaC — no peer review or drift detection
findings.description: Kubernetes manifests exist providing partial IaC. No CI/CD pipeline enforcing peer review on infrastructure changes, no drift detection. Legacy scp deployment target still present.
findings.gap: IaC exists but lacks automated plan review, peer review enforcement, and drift detection.
findings.recommendation: Adopt GitOps (ArgoCD/Flux) for PR-based review. Remove legacy scp deployment path.

findings.title: No CI/CD pipeline
findings.description: No CI/CD pipeline exists. No GitHub Actions, no GitLab CI, no Jenkinsfile. The README states no one can reproduce the build. Changes cannot be validated automatically.
findings.gap: No pipeline to catch API-breaking changes before deployment.
findings.recommendation: Create CI pipeline that builds Docker image and runs smoke tests.

findings.title: Basic Kubernetes rollback only — no automated triggers
findings.description: Kubernetes Deployment supports kubectl rollout undo for basic rollback. No automated rollback triggers, no canary deployment, no traffic shifting.
findings.gap: No automated rollback on error rate spikes. Manual intervention required.
findings.recommendation: Add Argo Rollouts or Flagger for automated canary with rollback.

findings.title: No staging environment — Docker provides minimal local testing only
findings.description: Dockerfile enables local container execution with a single sample SKU. No dedicated staging environment with production-equivalent data.
findings.gap: No production-equivalent staging environment for agent testing.
findings.recommendation: Create staging k8s namespace with production-equivalent pricing rules data.

findings.title: No write operations — idempotency not applicable
findings.description: The application has no write operations. All requests are read-only price lookups. Idempotency is not applicable.
findings.gap: N/A for current read-only scope.
findings.recommendation: Implement idempotency keys if write operations are added in the future.

findings.title: Response format is HTML — not ideal for agent consumption
findings.description: API returns Content-Type: text/html with HTML-formatted responses. LLMs can parse HTML but this adds complexity and fragility.
findings.gap: Agent tools must include HTML parsing logic. JSON would enable direct tool consumption.
findings.recommendation: Add a JSON response mode via Accept header or format query parameter.

findings.title: No rate limit documentation or headers
findings.description: No rate limit documentation. No X-RateLimit-Remaining or Retry-After headers. Agents have no visibility into throttling limits.
findings.gap: Agents cannot self-throttle without rate limit headers.
findings.recommendation: Include standard rate limit headers when rate limiting is implemented.

findings.title: No identity propagation — downgraded for stateless-utility
findings.description: No identity propagation mechanisms. No JWT parsing, no token exchange. Downgraded to INFO for stateless-utility archetype serving public pricing data.
findings.gap: No user context propagation.
findings.recommendation: Implement if user-specific pricing is introduced.

findings.title: No agent identities to suspend
findings.description: No auth surface and no write operations. No identities exist to suspend.
findings.gap: Suspension becomes relevant when machine identity is implemented.
findings.recommendation: Ensure chosen identity mechanism supports per-identity revocation.

findings.title: No write operations — compensation/rollback not applicable
findings.description: No write operations exist. Compensation/rollback is not applicable for this stateless-utility.
findings.gap: Not applicable.
findings.recommendation: No action required unless write operations are introduced.

findings.title: Read-only application — transaction limits not applicable
findings.description: Application is read-only. No records modified, no spend triggered. Transaction limits not applicable.
findings.gap: Not applicable for read-only scope.
findings.recommendation: No action required for current read-only scope.

findings.title: Public pricing data — not a sensitive data target
findings.description: Stage A = No. System handles public product pricing data (SKU codes and prices from flat file). Not PII, PHI, financial records, or credentials.
findings.gap: None — data is public/reference-grade.
findings.recommendation: No action required unless user-specific pricing is introduced.

findings.title: No persistent data store — residency not applicable
findings.description: No persistent data store and no user-data logging. Static reference pricing data with no residency requirements.
findings.gap: Not applicable.
findings.recommendation: No action required.

findings.title: No user data or PII handled — log redaction not applicable
findings.description: System does not log user data and holds no PII. Stateless-utility archetype does not handle user PII.
findings.gap: Not applicable.
findings.recommendation: No action required.

findings.title: No automated tests — INFO for stateless-utility
findings.description: No automated tests exist. README states correctness is validated by spot-checking output. Evaluated as INFO for stateless-utility archetype.
findings.gap: No test coverage for agent-consumed endpoint.
findings.recommendation: Add basic smoke tests validating price lookups for known SKUs.

findings.title: No Machine Identity Authentication
findings.description: The application uses a single static hardcoded API key for all callers with no principal attribution. All consumers share the same key and cannot be distinguished.
findings.gap: No machine identity authentication exists. No OAuth2 client credentials, no mTLS, no service accounts, no per-caller identity.
findings.recommendation: Replace the shared static API key with per-consumer API keys issued through AWS API Gateway with usage plans, enabling individual caller identification.

findings.title: No Scoped Permissions
findings.description: Single shared API key grants uniform access to all endpoints. No mechanism to differentiate access levels between callers.
findings.gap: No scoped permissions. All callers have identical access to GET /rates and POST /quote.
findings.recommendation: Introduce API Gateway with per-consumer API keys and usage plans that restrict endpoint access.

findings.title: No Action-Level Authorization
findings.description: No action-level authorization exists. The single API key check grants full access to all operations equally.
findings.gap: No RBAC, no ABAC, no per-action permission checks. Cannot restrict a caller to read-only access.
findings.recommendation: Implement method-level authorization via API Gateway resource policies or application middleware.

findings.title: Hardcoded Credentials in Source Code
findings.description: API key is hardcoded in source code. MongoDB connection string with server IP is also hardcoded. No secrets management system is used.
findings.gap: Credentials embedded in source code with no rotation capability. Exposed to anyone with repository access and persists in git history.
findings.recommendation: Migrate credentials to AWS Secrets Manager with rotation. Complete k8s Secret integration already referenced in deployment.yaml.

findings.title: No Audit Logging
findings.description: No audit logging exists. No request logging, no CloudTrail configuration, no CloudWatch Logs. Only a startup console.log message.
findings.gap: No audit trail for API calls. Cannot determine who called what endpoint or when.
findings.recommendation: Add structured request logging with caller identity. Configure CloudTrail with log file validation and S3 Object Lock.

findings.gap: Cannot trace or debug agent-initiated requests.
