findings.title: No Alerting Infrastructure
findings.description: No alerting. No CloudWatch alarms, no anomaly detection, no monitoring.
findings.gap: Cannot detect system degradation impacting agents.
findings.recommendation: Implement CloudWatch alarms for error rates and latency.

findings.title: No Infrastructure as Code
findings.description: No IaC. Manual VS publish to network share on IIS 6/Windows Server 2003.
findings.gap: Infrastructure not defined as code, no peer review, no drift detection.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to IaC (Terraform or CDK) with peer review and drift detection.

findings.title: No CI/CD Pipeline
findings.description: No CI/CD. Manual Visual Studio publish. No automated testing or contract testing.
findings.gap: No pipeline to catch breaking changes before agents are affected.
findings.recommendation: Implement CI/CD with API contract testing.

findings.title: No Rollback Capability
findings.description: Manual file copy deployment. No blue/green, no canary, no feature flags, no version tagging.
findings.gap: Cannot roll back broken deployments.
findings.recommendation: Implement automated deployment with rollback capability.

findings.title: Zero Test Coverage
findings.description: No tests exist. No unit tests, integration tests, or API tests.
findings.gap: No automated verification of API behavior.
findings.recommendation: Implement automated API tests covering core paths.

findings.title: No Encryption at Rest
findings.description: No encryption-at-rest config. SQL Server 2005 on Windows Server 2003 with no TDE or KMS.
findings.gap: Employee data stored unencrypted.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to RDS with KMS-encrypted storage.

findings.title: Immutable Audit Logging
findings.description: No audit logging of the authenticated principal for write operations. The upsertProduct and deleteProduct mutations do not log who performed the action. No CloudTrail configuration in the SAM template. No application-level audit event emission.
findings.gap: Write operations execute without recording the authenticated identity. If an agent modifies or deletes catalog data, there is no immutable record of which principal took the action.
findings.recommendation: Add an Apollo Server plugin that logs the authenticated principal (from JWT claims), operation name, and mutation variables to a structured CloudWatch log group with 365-day retention. Enable API Gateway access logging.

findings.title: Identity Propagation and Delegation
findings.description: JWT claims are extracted from the API Gateway Cognito authorizer and passed to resolvers as scopes. However, there is no mechanism to distinguish between an agent acting under its own service identity vs. acting on behalf of a specific human user.
findings.gap: No explicit distinction between agent-as-self and agent-on-behalf-of-user. All authenticated callers are treated identically based on JWT scopes.
findings.recommendation: Implement OAuth2 token exchange or add a custom claim (act claim per RFC 8693) to distinguish delegated calls. Log both the agent identity and the delegating user identity.

findings.title: Concurrency Controls
findings.description: DynamoDB writes in upsertProduct use unconditional put (last-write-wins) with no version field, conditional expression, or ETag. deleteProduct uses unconditional update. Multiple concurrent agent instances could overwrite each other's changes silently.
findings.gap: No optimistic locking or concurrency controls on write operations.
findings.recommendation: Add a version field and use DynamoDB ConditionExpression to implement optimistic locking. Return the version in GraphQL responses.

findings.title: Circuit Breakers and Resilience
findings.description: No explicit circuit breaker pattern implemented. The service depends on DynamoDB for all operations. AWS SDK v3 provides default retry with exponential backoff, and Lambda enforces a 30-second timeout, but no circuit breaker prevents cascading failures if DynamoDB experiences sustained degradation.
findings.gap: No fail-fast mechanism for sustained DynamoDB degradation. Sustained throttling would cause all Lambda invocations to consume their full timeout.
findings.recommendation: Implement a lightweight circuit breaker (e.g., opossum library) around DynamoDB calls that opens after N consecutive failures.

findings.title: Rate Limiting and Throttling
findings.description: No explicit rate limiting configuration in the SAM template. The API Gateway HTTP API uses AWS account-level default throttling but no per-API, per-route, or per-caller throttle is configured.
findings.gap: No explicit rate limits to prevent a runaway agent loop from overwhelming the service.
findings.recommendation: Add ThrottlingBurstLimit and ThrottlingRateLimit to the HttpApi resource. Consider WAF rate rules for per-client throttling.

findings.title: Blast Radius and Transaction Limits
findings.description: No business-level transaction limits exist. An agent with catalog:write scope could call upsertProduct or deleteProduct in a loop without any cap on records modified per session or time window.
findings.gap: No configurable limits on records modified per agent identity per time window.
findings.recommendation: Implement per-caller write quotas (e.g., max 100 upserts/hour per client_id) enforced at the resolver layer.

findings.title: Draft/Pending State
findings.description: All write operations are immediately committed. upsertProduct immediately persists the product, and deleteProduct immediately soft-deletes. There is no draft, pending, or proposed state for human review.
findings.gap: No mechanism for an agent to propose changes that a human can review before they take effect.
findings.recommendation: Add a status field to products with values like DRAFT/ACTIVE. Agent-initiated writes create products in DRAFT status requiring human promotion.

findings.title: Configurable Approval Gates
findings.description: No configurable approval gates exist. All mutations execute immediately upon receiving a valid authenticated request with the required scope.
findings.gap: Cannot configure specific operations to require human approval before execution.
findings.recommendation: Implement a configurable approval workflow for high-risk operations (e.g., bulk updates, deletes above a threshold).

findings.title: Structured Error Responses
findings.description: Error handling relies on Apollo Server's default error formatting. Authorization errors throw Error('forbidden: requires scope ...') without custom error codes. DynamoDB SDK errors propagate without structured classification.
findings.gap: No custom GraphQL error codes, no retryable indicator. Agents cannot programmatically distinguish retriable from terminal errors.
findings.recommendation: Add a custom Apollo error formatter that maps errors to structured codes (FORBIDDEN, NOT_FOUND, THROTTLED, INTERNAL) with a retryable boolean in extensions.

findings.title: Temporal Metadata and Freshness
findings.description: Products have an updatedAt field set to ISO 8601 UTC. However, there is no createdAt field and no response-level freshness signaling (Cache-Control, staleness indicators).
findings.gap: Partial temporal metadata — no creation timestamp, no freshness signaling.
findings.recommendation: Add a createdAt field populated on first insert. Consider freshness headers in GraphQL responses.

findings.title: Schema Versioning and API Contracts
findings.description: A GraphQL schema file exists providing a documented API contract. However, there is no schema versioning strategy, no breaking-change detection tooling, no changelog, and no contract tests.
findings.gap: Schema changes could break agent tool bindings without detection.
findings.recommendation: Add a schema comparison step to CI (e.g., graphql-inspector) that detects breaking changes. Maintain a schema changelog.

findings.title: Distributed Tracing and Structured Logging
findings.description: X-Ray tracing is active (Tracing: Active in SAM Globals). However, no structured JSON logging library is installed or configured. No explicit logging statements, request correlation IDs, or structured log output in the codebase.
findings.gap: Tracing present but structured logging with correlation IDs is absent.
findings.recommendation: Add @aws-lambda-powertools/logger for structured JSON logs with trace ID and request ID. Add an Apollo Server plugin for request-level logging.

findings.title: Alerting on Error Rates and Latency
findings.description: No CloudWatch alarms or alerting configuration defined in the SAM template. No anomaly detection, no integration with alerting services.
findings.gap: No alerting to detect when the API is degraded for agents.
findings.recommendation: Add CloudWatch alarms for Lambda error rate > 5%, p99 latency > 5s, and DynamoDB throttled requests > 0.

findings.title: Infrastructure Governance for Agent-Facing Surface
findings.description: Infrastructure is defined as code (SAM template.yaml) defining API Gateway, Lambda, and DynamoDB. However, no peer review enforcement and no drift detection are present.
findings.gap: IaC exists (1/3 governance sub-checks) but no automated review enforcement or drift detection.
findings.recommendation: Add a CI/CD pipeline with required PR reviews for IaC changes. Enable AWS Config rules for drift detection.

findings.title: CI/CD with API Contract Testing
findings.description: No CI/CD pipeline configuration files found in the repository. package.json defines build, test, and lint scripts for local development only.
findings.gap: No automated pipeline to catch API-breaking changes before deployment.
findings.recommendation: Add a CI/CD pipeline that runs lint, test, build, and schema comparison on every PR.

findings.title: Rollback Capability
findings.description: No explicit rollback configuration. No blue/green deployment, no canary, no CodeDeploy. CloudFormation provides implicit rollback only on stack update failure.
findings.gap: No fast rollback mechanism for successful-but-broken deployments.
findings.recommendation: Enable Lambda DeploymentPreference with canary/linear and automatic rollback on CloudWatch alarm trigger.

findings.title: API Test Coverage
findings.description: vitest is configured as a dev dependency with a test script, but no test files exist in the repository. Zero automated test coverage.
findings.gap: No tests for the APIs agents will consume.
findings.recommendation: Add resolver unit tests covering successful queries, pagination, scope enforcement, error responses, and idempotent upsert.

findings.title: Sandbox/Staging Environment
findings.description: No sandbox or staging environment configuration in the repository. No docker-compose for local testing, no seed data scripts, no environment-specific configurations.
findings.gap: No safe environment to test agent behavior before production.
findings.recommendation: Add samconfig.toml with staging/production environments. Add docker-compose with DynamoDB Local for local agent testing.

findings.title: Event Emission for State Changes
findings.description: No event emission for state changes. Product upserts and soft-deletes do not publish events to SNS, EventBridge, SQS, or any event bus.
findings.gap: No reactive event surface for downstream consumers or agents.
findings.recommendation: Add EventBridge integration to emit events on product create/update/delete.

findings.title: Rate Limit Documentation and Headers
findings.description: No rate limit documentation or headers. The API does not return X-RateLimit-Remaining, Retry-After, or similar headers.
findings.gap: Agents cannot self-throttle based on remaining capacity.
findings.recommendation: Document rate limits in schema description. Configure API Gateway to return throttling headers.

findings.title: Sensitive Data Classification
findings.description: Product catalog data (SKU, name, description, price, currency, active status) contains no PII, PHI, financial records, or credentials. Not a data-handling target for sensitive data.
findings.gap: None — no sensitive data present in this system.
findings.recommendation: Monitor schema evolution — re-evaluate if user-specific or regulated data is added.

findings.title: Data Quality Awareness
findings.description: No data quality metrics, completeness monitoring, or profiling for the product catalog.
findings.gap: No completeness or quality tracking.
findings.recommendation: Add custom metrics for catalog data quality (completeness, anomalies).

findings.title: Data Catalog / Metadata Layer
findings.description: No dedicated data catalog or metadata layer. The GraphQL schema provides structural documentation but not semantic data lineage or business glossary.
findings.gap: No business glossary or data lineage documentation.
findings.recommendation: Add descriptions to all GraphQL schema fields documenting business meaning.

findings.title: Business Outcome Metrics
findings.description: No custom business outcome metrics published. Only infrastructure-level metrics via Lambda defaults and X-Ray.
findings.gap: No agent-outcome measurement capability.
findings.recommendation: Add custom CloudWatch metrics for catalog operations (products_upserted, products_deleted, queries_per_minute).

findings.title: Machine Identity Authentication — Gateway Unauthenticated
findings.description: The AgentCore Gateway (primary MCP tool surface) has AuthorizerType: NONE. Any caller that can reach the endpoint can invoke any tool including settlement_writer which moves money. No principal attribution exists in logs.
findings.gap: No machine identity authentication on the agent-facing MCP Gateway. No principal attribution in audit logs.
findings.recommendation: Add an IAM or Lambda authorizer to the AgentCore Gateway that validates caller identity and propagates the principal to downstream logs.

findings.title: Non-Idempotent Settlement Writer
findings.description: settlement_writer performs UPDATE + INSERT with no idempotency protection. Duplicate calls create duplicate payment_queue rows and release duplicate payments.
findings.gap: Non-idempotent write operation on a financial transaction. Agent retries or LLM non-determinism will cause duplicate payments.
findings.recommendation: Add a unique constraint on (claim_id) in payment_queue and use INSERT ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING or check claim status before writing.

findings.title: Mutable Audit Logs Without Principal Attribution
findings.description: CloudWatch logs exist with 10-year retention but are mutable, record no authenticated principal (Gateway has no auth), and have no tamper-evident storage. No CloudTrail for API-level auditing.
findings.gap: No immutable, tamper-evident audit trail attributing write operations to specific agent identities.
findings.recommendation: Export CloudWatch logs to S3 with Object Lock. Add CloudTrail. Include principal identity from Gateway auth in every log entry.

findings.title: No Compensation or Rollback for Settlements
findings.description: settlement_writer commits immediately with no compensation or undo mechanism. Batch mode processes up to 500 claims with manual-only rollback.
findings.gap: No automated compensation or rollback for agent-initiated write operations.
findings.recommendation: Implement two-phase settlement: write with status PENDING_SETTLEMENT, then a separate confirmation step. Add automated reversal endpoint.

findings.title: Sensitive PII Returned Unfiltered in Tool Responses
findings.description: Agent-facing tool responses return sensitive PII unfiltered: load_claim returns claimant_ssn, payment_history returns routing_no and account_last4. No access control differentiation. No data classification metadata.
findings.gap: B1: Agent-facing APIs return PII/financial data (SSN, bank routing numbers) unfiltered. B2: No access control differentiation. B3: No classification metadata.
findings.recommendation: Remove claimant_ssn from load_claim response. Remove routing_no from payment_history. Create separately-authorized endpoints for sensitive field access.

findings.title: No Data Residency Controls for Regulated PII
findings.description: Regulated PII (SSN, financial data) transmitted to Bedrock model with no explicit residency controls. MODEL_ID configurable via env var. Memory stores raw PII. No SCPs, VPC endpoints, or compliance documentation.
findings.gap: No documented or enforced data residency controls for regulated PII transmitted to LLM and stored in memory.
findings.recommendation: Document data residency requirements. Add VPC endpoints for Bedrock. Add SCP preventing cross-region invocations. Restrict MODEL_ID to approved in-region models.

findings.title: All IAM Policies Use Wildcard Resources
findings.description: All IAM policy statements use Resource: '*'. Single shared role (claims-agent-execution) for Runtime and Lambda. A tool compromise gets model and memory permissions.
findings.gap: No mechanism to scope agent permissions. All permissions wildcard. Single shared role across components.
findings.recommendation: Split into separate roles per component. Replace Resource: '*' with specific resource ARNs.

findings.title: No Action-Level Authorization on Tools
findings.description: All tools exposed to all callers without filtering. settlement_writer (moves money) accessible to same callers as policy_lookup (read-only). No per-caller tool allow-list.
findings.gap: Cannot restrict agents to read-only tools. No mechanism to differentiate read vs write access.
findings.recommendation: Implement per-caller tool allow-list in Gateway configuration. Separate read-only tools from write tools.

findings.title: No Identity Propagation — Unverified actor_id
findings.description: No identity propagation. Gateway is unauthenticated so no identity to propagate. actor_id defaults to 'adjuster-pool' — an unverified caller-supplied string.
findings.gap: Cannot distinguish agent-as-self from agent-on-behalf-of-user. No verified identity flow.
findings.recommendation: Propagate authenticated principal from Gateway authorizer as actor_id. Reject mismatched identities.

findings.title: No Agent Identity Suspension Mechanism
findings.description: No mechanism to suspend individual agent identities. Gateway unauthenticated. Runtime accepts any account principal. Only option is deleting entire stack.
findings.gap: Cannot isolate a misbehaving agent without taking down the entire platform.
findings.recommendation: Implement per-identity revocation after adding Gateway authentication.

findings.title: No Concurrency Controls on Settlements
findings.description: No optimistic locking, version fields, or SELECT FOR UPDATE. settlement_writer performs bare UPDATE/INSERT with no conflict detection.
findings.gap: Race conditions possible under concurrent agent instances. Same claim can be settled multiple times.
findings.recommendation: Add WHERE status = 'OPEN' condition to UPDATE. Verify rows affected = 1 before INSERT.

findings.title: No Circuit Breakers or Resilience Patterns
findings.description: No circuit breakers, retry logic, or timeout configuration on any of 5 external dependencies (Bedrock, SecretsManager, PostgreSQL, Knowledge Base, Memory).
findings.gap: Single dependency failure cascades through entire triage operation. No resilience patterns.
findings.recommendation: Configure explicit timeouts on all clients. Add retry with exponential backoff. Consider circuit breaker for database.

findings.title: No Rate Limiting on Gateway or Runtime
findings.description: No rate limiting or throttling configured. PUBLIC network mode with no traffic controls. No WAF, no API Gateway usage plan, no application-level throttling.
findings.gap: No protection against agent traffic storms or runaway loops.
findings.recommendation: Add WAF rate rule or API Gateway throttling to the Gateway. Configure per-caller limits.

findings.title: No Transaction Limits — Unbounded Blast Radius
findings.description: No dollar ceiling on settlements. No per-run claim count limit. Batch mode bypasses UI threshold. Agent can settle unlimited amounts with no cap.
findings.gap: Unbounded blast radius. No dollar ceiling, no claim count limit, no per-session caps.
findings.recommendation: Add configurable limits: max settlement amount, max settlements per run, max spend per hour. Enforce in tool code.

findings.title: No Draft/Pending State for Settlements
findings.description: settlement_writer commits directly to SETTLED status and releases payment immediately. No intermediate state for human review. Batch mode has no approval step.
findings.gap: No reviewable intermediate state. All writes immediately committed and payment released.
findings.recommendation: Implement PENDING_REVIEW status. Separate settlement recommendation from settlement execution.

findings.title: Approval Gates Exist Only in UI — Bypassed by Batch
findings.description: Auto-approve threshold check exists only in adjuster UI. Batch mode bypasses all approvals. No configurable operation-level approval flags in application code.
findings.gap: No application-layer approval gates. Safety checks are UI-only and bypassed by programmatic access.
findings.recommendation: Move auto-approve threshold into settlement_writer. Route high-value settlements to human review queue.

findings.title: PII Logged Unredacted with 10-Year Retention
findings.description: agent.py logs full prompts and completions including claimant SSNs, bank routing numbers, and financial data. CloudWatch retention is 10 years. No redaction, no data-protection policy.
findings.gap: PII (SSN, bank routing numbers, financial data) logged unredacted with long retention.
findings.recommendation: Add PII redaction to logging pipeline. Mask SSN and bank number patterns. Add data-protection policy to log group.

findings.title: No Machine-Readable API Specification
findings.description: No OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, or Smithy specification. Tool schemas advertised to model have empty inputSchema with no parameter documentation.
findings.gap: No machine-readable spec. Agent tool generation requires manual work.
findings.recommendation: Define complete JSON schemas for tool inputs in _tool_specs(). Consider generating MCP tool manifest.

findings.title: No Structured Error Responses
findings.description: No error handling in tool functions. Null results crash with TypeError. No error codes, retryable indicators, or consistent error format.
findings.gap: No structured error responses. Agent cannot distinguish retriable from terminal errors.
findings.recommendation: Add try/except wrappers returning structured error dicts with code, message, and retryable fields.

findings.title: No Async Pattern for Long-Running Operations
findings.description: All operations synchronous. Lambda timeout 60s. Batch mode processes 500 claims sequentially with no job status API or polling.
findings.gap: No async support for potentially long-running operations.
findings.recommendation: Implement job submission pattern for batch mode with status polling endpoint.

findings.title: No Sandbox/Staging Environment
findings.description: No staging environment configuration. No docker-compose, no seed data, no synthetic data generators. Tests are fully mocked.
findings.gap: No safe environment to test agent behavior before production.
findings.recommendation: Create staging environment with synthetic claims data and docker-compose for local development.

findings.title: Unbounded Results from payment_history
findings.description: payment_history returns all payments for a policy with no LIMIT, pagination, or filtering. Could overwhelm LLM context window.
findings.gap: Unbounded result set from payment_history. No pagination parameters.
findings.recommendation: Add LIMIT and OFFSET parameters. Default to recent N payments.

findings.title: No Input Validation Beyond Parameterized SQL
findings.description: No type checking, format validation, or business rule enforcement on tool inputs. Parameterized queries prevent injection but don't validate business logic.
findings.gap: No systematic validation at API boundary. No business rule enforcement.
findings.recommendation: Add type, format, and business rule validation (e.g., amount > 0, claim_id format check).

findings.title: Incomplete Temporal Metadata
findings.description: Minimal timestamps. Claims lack created_at/updated_at. Memory events have null timestamps. No freshness signaling.
findings.gap: Incomplete temporal metadata on claims. No freshness signaling mechanism.
findings.recommendation: Add timestamps to claims queries. Pass actual timestamps to memory. Add freshness indicators.

findings.title: No Schema Versioning or Contract Testing
findings.description: No versioned schemas, no OpenAPI spec, no breaking change detection, no CI pipeline. Tool schemas have empty properties.
findings.gap: Tool interface changes break agent bindings silently. No contract enforcement.
findings.recommendation: Define versioned JSON schemas for tools. Add contract tests. Integrate into CI.

findings.title: No Distributed Tracing or Structured Logging
findings.description: No X-Ray or OpenTelemetry. Plain text logging format. No correlation IDs. Cannot reconstruct end-to-end agent sessions.
findings.gap: Cannot reconstruct agent sessions across Gateway, Runtime, and Memory.
findings.recommendation: Add OpenTelemetry instrumentation. Switch to JSON logging. Add correlation_id field.

findings.title: No Alerting Configuration
findings.description: No CloudWatch alarms for error rates, latency, or anomalies. Only a log group exists. Agent degradation goes undetected.
findings.gap: No alerting on agent-facing surface. Degradation undetected.
findings.recommendation: Add CloudWatch alarms for Lambda errors, duration, Bedrock failures, and DB connection failures.

findings.title: IaC Exists but Lacks Review and Drift Detection
findings.description: CloudFormation templates define infrastructure but no peer review enforcement, no drift detection, and deploy role accessible without MFA.
findings.gap: Missing review requirements and drift detection on IaC changes.
findings.recommendation: Add branch protection for infra/ changes. Enable AWS Config drift detection. Require MFA on deploy role.

findings.title: No CI/CD Pipeline or Contract Testing
findings.description: No CI/CD configuration in repository. No contract tests. Releases promoted on unit tests only. No pre-deployment safety evaluation.
findings.gap: No automated pipeline. No contract validation before production.
findings.recommendation: Implement CI/CD with contract tests and safety evaluation gate.

findings.title: No Rollback Capability — Mutable Container Tag
findings.description: No blue/green, canary, or automatic rollback. Container image referenced as :latest in IaC (mutable tag).
findings.gap: No automated rollback. Mutable container tag prevents reliable version pinning.
findings.recommendation: Pin container to immutable digest. Implement blue/green with rollback triggers.

findings.title: Minimal Test Coverage — Happy Path Only
findings.description: 2 unit tests (happy path, mocked DB). No error cases, adversarial inputs, integration tests, or contract tests. Not connected to CI.
findings.gap: Insufficient test coverage for agent-facing tools.
findings.recommendation: Add error, edge case, and integration tests. Connect to CI pipeline.

findings.title: No Explicit Encryption at Rest Configuration
findings.description: No KMS keys in IaC. Log group storing PII has no explicit encryption. Relies on service defaults.
findings.gap: No explicit encryption at rest for PII data stores.
findings.recommendation: Add customer-managed KMS keys for log group and data stores.

findings.title: No Event Emission for State Changes
findings.description: No event publishing on settlement or payment release. No SNS/EventBridge integration. Downstream systems must poll database.
findings.gap: State changes not externally observable without DB polling.
findings.recommendation: Publish settlement events to EventBridge.

findings.title: No Rate Limit Documentation or Headers
findings.description: No rate limit documentation or response headers on the Gateway. Agents cannot self-throttle.
findings.gap: No visibility into traffic limits for agent callers.
findings.recommendation: Add X-RateLimit-Remaining and Retry-After headers when throttling is implemented.

findings.title: No Data Quality Metrics
findings.description: No data quality metrics, profiling, or completeness monitoring for claims data or knowledge base corpus.
findings.gap: No awareness of data completeness or quality.
findings.recommendation: Add data profiling. Establish freshness SLA for knowledge base ingestion.

findings.title: No Data Catalog or Metadata Layer
findings.description: No data catalog, Glue catalog, or data dictionary. Schema only implicit from SQL queries in tools.py.
findings.gap: Data model undocumented beyond source code.
findings.recommendation: Document claims database schema in structured format.

findings.title: No Business Outcome Metrics
findings.description: No custom CloudWatch metrics for settlement rates, amounts, accuracy, or throughput. Cannot measure agent recommendation quality.
findings.gap: Cannot detect systematic over- or under-settlement.
findings.recommendation: Publish settlement metrics. Create agent quality dashboard.

findings.title: Idempotent Write Operations
findings.description: Write endpoints lack idempotency controls. POST /orders/:id/refund issues a real money movement with no Idempotency-Key — a duplicate call double-refunds. POST /orders/:id/cancel triggers warehouse dispatch cancellation with no idempotency. POST /orders creates new orders without deduplication.
findings.gap: No idempotency key support on any write endpoint. No unique constraint enforcement on business keys for deduplication.
findings.recommendation: Implement Idempotency-Key header support with server-side deduplication. Store idempotency keys with response in a dedicated table; return cached response on duplicate.

findings.title: Immutable Audit Logging
findings.description: No audit logging for write operations. The DELETE /orders/:id operation removes data permanently with no record of who deleted what. No CloudTrail configuration in IaC. CloudWatch logs are configured but there is no structured audit logging recording the authenticated principal for each write operation.
findings.gap: No immutable audit trail for agent-initiated write operations. Cannot prove compliance or conduct forensics after an agent action.
findings.recommendation: Add structured audit log entries for all write operations that include: timestamp, authenticated principal, action, resource ID, and outcome. Store in immutable storage (CloudTrail + S3 Object Lock).

findings.title: Compensation and Rollback
findings.description: No compensation or rollback logic for any write operation. hardDelete permanently removes data with no undo. refund calls an external payment processor irreversibly. cancelAndRecallShipment triggers an irreversible downstream side effect with no compensation.
findings.gap: Multi-step agent workflows that fail mid-sequence leave the application in an unrecoverable partial state. No mechanism to reverse any completed step.
findings.recommendation: Replace hardDelete with soft-delete. Add compensation endpoint for refund. Implement saga pattern for multi-step workflows involving warehouse and payment services.

findings.title: Data Residency and Sovereignty
findings.description: The service stores customer PII (customer_id linked to financial transaction data) in PostgreSQL on RDS. No data residency assessment exists. No GDPR/LGPD compliance documentation. No region-pinning in IaC.
findings.gap: No documented assessment of data residency requirements. Cannot confirm whether an agent can safely transmit customer order data to an LLM provider in another jurisdiction.
findings.recommendation: Conduct a data residency assessment for the customer order data. Document data sovereignty policy. Add region-pinning in IaC with enforcement.

findings.title: Action-Level Authorization
findings.description: Authorization distinguishes read (orders:read) from write (orders:write), but all write operations share the same role. An agent with orders:write can create, delete, refund, AND cancel.
findings.gap: Cannot restrict an agent to specific write operations within the same resource type.
findings.recommendation: Add fine-grained roles: orders:create, orders:delete, orders:refund, orders:cancel. Update requireRole middleware.

findings.title: Identity Propagation and Delegation
findings.description: JWT middleware verifies tokens and extracts role claims but does not distinguish between agent-as-self vs agent-on-behalf-of-user. No token exchange patterns. Downstream calls to WarehouseClient do not propagate caller identity.
findings.gap: Cannot distinguish agent-as-self from agent-on-behalf-of-user. No identity context in downstream calls.
findings.recommendation: Implement token exchange or on-behalf-of flow. Pass identity context to downstream WarehouseClient calls.

findings.title: Agent Identity Suspension
findings.description: Authentication relies on external JWKS-validated JWT tokens. No in-application mechanism to immediately suspend a specific agent identity. Existing valid tokens remain functional until expiry.
findings.gap: Cannot immediately isolate a misbehaving agent without waiting for token expiry.
findings.recommendation: Add a token/principal deny-list checked in the auth middleware. Allow immediate revocation of specific agent principals.

findings.title: Concurrency Controls
findings.description: No optimistic locking, no version fields, no ETags, no SELECT FOR UPDATE, no conditional writes. Multiple concurrent agent instances could refund the same order simultaneously.
findings.gap: No concurrency protection. Race conditions from concurrent agent instances can corrupt state.
findings.recommendation: Add a version column to the orders table. Implement optimistic locking on all UPDATE/DELETE queries.

findings.title: Circuit Breakers and Resilience
findings.description: No circuit breaker library in dependencies. No retry logic with backoff. No timeout configuration on WarehouseClient calls.
findings.gap: Cascading failures from dependency outages. No resilience patterns on external calls.
findings.recommendation: Add circuit breaker library. Configure timeout, retry with exponential backoff on WarehouseClient calls.

findings.title: Rate Limiting and Throttling
findings.description: No rate limiting middleware. No API Gateway in IaC. No WAF rules. No per-client throttling. SAFETY.md explicitly identifies this gap.
findings.gap: No protection against runaway agent loops overwhelming the service.
findings.recommendation: Add rate-limiting middleware or API Gateway. Configure per-client limits with Retry-After headers.

findings.title: Blast Radius and Transaction Limits
findings.description: No configurable transaction limits. No max refunds per hour, no max deletes per session, no spend caps per agent identity. Unbounded blast radius.
findings.gap: Maximum blast radius of an agent error is unbounded. No business-logic limits on operation volume.
findings.recommendation: Add configurable per-caller business limits: max_refund_amount_per_hour, max_deletes_per_session.

findings.title: Draft/Pending State
findings.description: No draft or pending state. All write operations commit immediately. DELETE removes the row, refund issues to payment processor, cancel triggers warehouse recall — all immediately.
findings.gap: No mechanism for an agent to propose an action for human review before execution.
findings.recommendation: Add PENDING_REVIEW status. Implement two-step APIs: propose action → confirm action.

findings.title: Configurable Approval Gates
findings.description: No approval gates. No confirmation step before irreversible operations. No configurable flags for requiring approval per operation type.
findings.gap: High-risk operations execute without human confirmation option.
findings.recommendation: Add operation-level approval configuration. High-risk operations should require an approval token.

findings.title: Sensitive Data Classification
findings.description: Customer PII (customer_id) linked to financial data (total_cents, refund amounts) is stored and returned in API responses. Access controls only distinguish read vs write with no sensitivity-based differentiation.
findings.gap: No access control differentiation between sensitive and non-sensitive data. A single orders:read permission grants access to all fields.
findings.recommendation: Implement OAuth scope-based field filtering. Create summary vs full response DTOs.

findings.title: PII Redaction in Logs
findings.description: No PII redaction in logging pipeline. No log scrubbing middleware. No PII masking libraries. Customer_id and financial data may leak into CloudWatch logs.
findings.gap: Customer PII may leak into application logs without redaction.
findings.recommendation: Configure pino redact option to mask customer_id and financial fields.

findings.title: Structured Error Responses
findings.description: Structured JSON errors with {code, message} for 401/403/404. No retryable indicator. Server-level errors use Fastify defaults.
findings.gap: No retryable boolean or retry guidance for all error types.
findings.recommendation: Add retryable field and implement global Fastify error handler with consistent format.

findings.title: Asynchronous Operation Support
findings.description: No async patterns for potentially long-running warehouse and payment operations. Refund and cancel execute synchronously in the request cycle.
findings.gap: Long-running operations have no async fallback. Agent timeouts will create orphaned processes.
findings.recommendation: Implement async job pattern: accept request, return 202 with job ID, provide polling endpoint.

findings.title: Sandbox/Staging Environment
findings.description: No staging or sandbox environment. No docker-compose. Only production-targeted ECS IaC.
findings.gap: No safe environment to test agent behavior without risking production.
findings.recommendation: Add docker-compose.yml for local testing. Create staging CloudFormation stack with synthetic data.

findings.title: Input Validation and Schema Enforcement
findings.description: No input validation library. POST /orders accepts req.body as Record<string, unknown> with no schema validation. Parameterized queries prevent injection but no business-rule validation exists.
findings.gap: Endpoints accept arbitrary input shapes without validation.
findings.recommendation: Add validation library (zod or @sinclair/typebox). Define request schemas for all endpoints.

findings.title: Temporal Metadata and Freshness
findings.description: Order interface has no created_at, updated_at, or event_time fields. No timestamp handling visible. No freshness signaling.
findings.gap: Agents cannot determine data currency or freshness.
findings.recommendation: Add created_at and updated_at columns. Include timestamps in API responses.

findings.title: Schema Versioning and API Contracts
findings.description: OpenAPI spec exists with version 2.1.0. No URL-path versioning, no breaking change detection in CI, no consumer-driven contract tests.
findings.gap: No automated detection of breaking API changes. Agent tool bindings can break silently.
findings.recommendation: Add URL versioning and CI-based breaking change detection (openapi-diff).

findings.title: Distributed Tracing and Structured Logging
findings.description: Structured JSON logging via Fastify's built-in pino logger. CloudWatch logs configured. No distributed tracing SDK (no OpenTelemetry, no X-Ray).
findings.gap: Cannot trace agent requests across service boundaries.
findings.recommendation: Add @opentelemetry/sdk-node with AWS X-Ray exporter. Instrument WarehouseClient calls.

findings.title: Alerting on Error Rates and Latency
findings.description: No CloudWatch alarms defined in IaC. No alerting for error rates or latency.
findings.gap: No proactive detection of agent-caused anomalies.
findings.recommendation: Add CloudWatch alarms for 5xx error rate and P99 latency.

findings.title: Infrastructure Governance
findings.description: IaC exists (CloudFormation) but no CI/CD pipeline for automated plan review and no drift detection configured.
findings.gap: IaC changes are unreviewed. Drift undetected.
findings.recommendation: Add CI/CD with change set review. Enable AWS Config drift detection.

findings.title: CI/CD with API Contract Testing
findings.description: No CI/CD pipeline exists. No automated testing of API contracts before production.
findings.gap: API-breaking changes reach production without testing.
findings.recommendation: Add CI/CD pipeline with OpenAPI spec validation and contract testing.

findings.title: API Test Coverage
findings.description: vitest configured but no test files exist in the repository. Zero test coverage for agent-facing APIs.
findings.gap: No automated test coverage for API behavior.
findings.recommendation: Add integration tests for all 5 endpoints. Run in CI.

findings.title: Encryption at Rest
findings.description: No KMS configuration in IaC. RDS not defined in this repo's IaC. Cannot confirm encryption at rest for PostgreSQL database.
findings.gap: Cannot confirm encryption at rest for customer data.
findings.recommendation: Add RDS to IaC with StorageEncrypted: true and customer-managed KMS key.

findings.title: Event Emission for State Changes
findings.description: No event emission. Status changes reflected only in database. No SNS/SQS/EventBridge integration.
findings.gap: No mechanism for reactive agent patterns.
findings.recommendation: Add EventBridge integration for order lifecycle events.

findings.title: Rate Limit Documentation and Headers
findings.description: No rate limits documented in OpenAPI spec. No X-RateLimit-Remaining or Retry-After headers. No API Gateway usage plan.
findings.gap: Agents cannot self-throttle based on quota information.
findings.recommendation: When rate limiting is implemented, include standard headers and document in OpenAPI spec.

findings.title: Data Quality Awareness
findings.description: No data quality monitoring. No null rate monitoring, duplicate detection, or freshness SLAs.
findings.gap: No signal when data quality degrades.
findings.recommendation: Add data quality checks and monitoring.

findings.title: Data Catalog / Metadata Layer
findings.description: No data catalog or metadata layer. Database schema visible only through SQL queries and TypeScript interface.
findings.gap: No self-service discovery mechanism for the data model.
findings.recommendation: Document data model in a schema file or data dictionary.

findings.title: Business Outcome Metrics
findings.description: No custom business metrics published. Only infrastructure-level observability.
findings.gap: Cannot measure agent effectiveness on business outcomes.
findings.recommendation: Add custom CloudWatch metrics for order operations.

findings.title: Immutable Audit Logging
findings.description: Structured logging is active via AWS Lambda Powertools with client_id and correlation_id on every write operation. X-Ray tracing is enabled. However, no immutable or tamper-evident log storage is configured. CloudWatch Logs can be deleted by any principal with logs:DeleteLogGroup permission.
findings.gap: Logs exist and contain principal attribution, but are not stored immutably. No tamper-evident log mechanism is configured.
findings.recommendation: Add CloudWatch Logs retention policy and configure log export to S3 bucket with Object Lock (compliance mode). Enable CloudTrail data events for the DynamoDB table.

findings.title: Data Residency and Sovereignty
findings.description: The system processes financial transaction data (payment charges and refunds). No data residency policy, compliance documentation, or cross-region data flow safeguards are documented or configured. The API Gateway uses a REGIONAL endpoint but no explicit controls prevent agent-to-LLM data transmission across jurisdictions.
findings.gap: No documented data residency requirements. No compliance markers. No technical safeguards for agent-to-LLM data transmission boundaries.
findings.recommendation: Document applicable data residency and compliance requirements. Add data handling boundary documentation specifying which fields an agent may transmit externally.

findings.title: Identity Propagation and Delegation
findings.description: The system authenticates machine clients via OAuth2 client-credentials flow. The authorizer extracts client_id and scopes but there is no mechanism to distinguish between an agent acting under its own service identity vs. acting on behalf of a specific human user.
findings.gap: No identity propagation or delegation mechanism. All requests are attributed to the machine client only.
findings.recommendation: Implement token exchange or on-behalf-of flow in the Lambda authorizer to carry user context when an agent operates on behalf of a human.

findings.title: Agent Identity Suspension
findings.description: The system uses Cognito for OAuth2 token issuance and a Lambda authorizer for validation. No explicit suspension mechanism is configured in the repository for immediate agent identity revocation.
findings.gap: No in-repo mechanism or documented procedure for immediately suspending a specific agent identity.
findings.recommendation: Implement a deny-list check in the Lambda authorizer that can be updated dynamically via DynamoDB or Parameter Store.

findings.title: Concurrency Controls
findings.description: The _idempotent_put function performs a get_item followed by put_item without a DynamoDB ConditionExpression. Two concurrent requests with the same Idempotency-Key could both observe no existing record and both write, resulting in inconsistent state.
findings.gap: No conditional writes or optimistic locking on the idempotency check. Race condition window between get_item and put_item.
findings.recommendation: Add ConditionExpression='attribute_not_exists(pk)' to the idempotency record put_item call and handle ConditionalCheckFailedException.

findings.title: Rate Limiting and Throttling
findings.description: No explicit rate limiting or throttling configuration is defined in the SAM template. No API Gateway usage plans, no throttle settings, no WAF rate rules. The API relies on default API Gateway account-level throttling which is shared and not per-client.
findings.gap: No per-client rate limiting configured.
findings.recommendation: Define an AWS::ApiGateway::UsagePlan resource in template.yaml with per-client throttle rates.

findings.title: Blast Radius and Transaction Limits
findings.description: No configurable business-level transaction limits exist. An agent can issue unlimited refunds or create unlimited charges without any per-caller caps on business impact.
findings.gap: No per-caller business transaction limits. An agent error could issue thousands of refunds without bound.
findings.recommendation: Add configurable per-client business limits (max_refund_amount_per_day, max_charges_per_hour) enforced in the handler.

findings.title: Draft/Pending State
findings.description: The Charge schema defines a status enum with pending/succeeded/failed, indicating the data model supports a pending state. However, the implementation sets status directly to 'succeeded' — no intermediate reviewable state is used.
findings.gap: No draft or pending workflow is active. Schema supports it but implementation bypasses it.
findings.recommendation: Implement a two-step flow where charges are created with status='pending' and require explicit confirmation.

findings.title: Configurable Approval Gates
findings.description: No configurable approval gates exist. All operations execute immediately upon API call. No Step Functions with human approval tasks or operation-level flags to require confirmation.
findings.gap: No mechanism to require human approval before high-value operations.
findings.recommendation: Add configurable amount thresholds that route high-value operations through an approval workflow.

findings.title: Schema Versioning and API Contracts
findings.description: OpenAPI spec is versioned (1.4.0), API uses URL versioning (/v1/), and spec is validated in CI. However, no breaking change detection tool is configured.
findings.gap: No automated breaking change detection between spec versions.
findings.recommendation: Add oasdiff or similar OpenAPI comparison tool to CI that fails the build on breaking changes.

findings.title: Alerting on Error Rates and Latency
findings.description: RUNBOOK.md documents alarms (payments-5xx >1% over 5min, idempotency-conflict >10/min, ddb-throttle) but these are not defined in IaC.
findings.gap: Alarms documented but not codified in IaC. No guarantee they are deployed.
findings.recommendation: Define documented alarms as AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm resources in template.yaml.

findings.title: Infrastructure Governance
findings.description: Infrastructure is fully defined as SAM/CloudFormation IaC. CI runs on push and pull_request. However, no drift detection is configured.
findings.gap: No drift detection. Manual changes would not be detected.
findings.recommendation: Add scheduled CloudFormation drift detection or AWS Config rules.

findings.title: API Test Coverage
findings.description: Three unit tests cover idempotency and scope denial for create_charge. No tests for refund_charge, no error response format tests, no edge case tests, no integration tests.
findings.gap: Limited test coverage — only happy path for create_charge and two error cases tested.
findings.recommendation: Expand test suite to cover refund_charge, validation errors (422), and edge cases. Add integration tests.

findings.title: Temporal Metadata and Freshness
findings.description: Charge and Refund records include created_at timestamps. The ledger is append-only. However, no data freshness signaling is implemented — no Cache-Control or ETag headers.
findings.gap: No freshness signaling. Agent cannot determine if GET response is authoritative or cached.
findings.recommendation: Add Cache-Control and/or ETag headers to GET responses.

findings.title: Sandbox/Staging Environment
findings.description: Tests use a DynamoDB Local stub fixture. RUNBOOK references --config-env prod. No staging environment IaC, no docker-compose, no seed data in the repository.
findings.gap: No in-repo staging or sandbox environment definition.
findings.recommendation: Add samconfig.toml with dev/staging/prod configs and docker-compose.yml for local testing.

findings.title: Event Emission for State Changes
findings.description: The system does not emit events or webhooks for state changes. All state is observable only via synchronous GET requests.
findings.gap: No asynchronous notification mechanism for state transitions.
findings.recommendation: Consider adding EventBridge event emission on charge and refund state transitions.

findings.title: Rate Limit Documentation and Headers
findings.description: No rate limit headers (X-RateLimit-Remaining, Retry-After) are returned in API responses. No rate limit documentation in OpenAPI spec.
findings.gap: Callers cannot discover or adapt to rate limits programmatically.
findings.recommendation: Add rate limit headers to responses and document limits in OpenAPI spec.

findings.title: Sensitive Data Classification
findings.description: System handles financial data. B1 (response scoping): CLEAR — sensitive fields excluded from responses. B2 (access differentiation): CLEAR — OAuth scopes separate read/write. B3 (formal classification): INFO — no classification tags or sensitivity annotations.
findings.gap: No formal data classification metadata on infrastructure resources.
findings.recommendation: Add data classification tags to DynamoDB table and S3 bucket resources.

findings.title: Data Quality Awareness
findings.description: No data quality scores, completeness metrics, or data profiling. Append-only design prevents corruption by construction.
findings.gap: No explicit quality scoring or completeness monitoring.
findings.recommendation: Consider monitoring null rates on required fields as a lightweight quality signal.

findings.title: Data Catalog / Metadata Layer
findings.description: No data catalog or metadata layer exists. The DynamoDB single-table design is documented only via code patterns.
findings.gap: No formal metadata layer describing data semantics.
findings.recommendation: Add a schema documentation file for the DynamoDB table structure.

findings.title: No Machine Identity Authentication
findings.description: The application only supports PHP session-based authentication via username/password login. No OAuth2 client credentials, API key, mTLS, or service account mechanism exists.
findings.gap: No machine identity authentication mechanism. Agents cannot authenticate with attributable service credentials.
findings.recommendation: Implement API key or OAuth2 client credentials authentication as a parallel auth path with per-agent identity attribution.

findings.title: No Idempotent Write Operations
findings.description: Write endpoints use uniqid() for ID generation with no idempotency key support. POST /api/orders creates a new order every invocation with no duplicate detection.
findings.gap: No idempotency keys, no duplicate detection, no idempotent behavior on retry for any write endpoint.
findings.recommendation: Add Idempotency-Key header support to critical write endpoints (order creation, shipping, return approval).

findings.title: No Immutable Audit Logging
findings.description: Order status changes are logged to a mutable MySQL table (order_status_history). No CloudTrail, no immutable storage, no tamper-evident logging. VPC Flow Logs exist but are network-level only.
findings.gap: No immutable, tamper-evident audit trail for write operations.
findings.recommendation: Enable CloudTrail with S3 Object Lock for immutable log storage. Log authenticated principal for every write operation.

findings.title: No Compensation or Rollback for Multi-Step Workflows
findings.description: The 7-step fulfillment workflow (validate → assign-warehouse → pick → pack → quality-check → ship → deliver) has no compensation or rollback mechanism across steps. Single-step DB transactions exist but no cross-step compensation.
findings.gap: No saga pattern, no compensating transactions, no undo endpoints for the multi-step fulfillment workflow.
findings.recommendation: Implement compensating actions for each fulfillment step (e.g., unassign-warehouse, cancel-shipment) or adopt a saga pattern.

findings.title: No Data Residency Controls
findings.description: Customer PII (names, emails, shipping addresses) stored in RDS with no data residency documentation, no cross-region transfer controls, and no data sovereignty policy for agent-LLM interactions.
findings.gap: No data residency documentation, no cross-region transfer controls, no sovereignty policy.
findings.recommendation: Document data residency requirements. Classify which fields may be sent to LLM providers. Configure VPC endpoints to restrict data egress.

findings.title: No Scoped Permissions
findings.description: Binary admin/customer roles only. No mechanism to create scoped agent identity with access limited to specific operations or resources.
findings.gap: No fine-grained permission scoping. Cannot restrict agent to specific endpoints or resources.
findings.recommendation: Implement fine-grained RBAC with configurable permission sets per identity.

findings.title: No Action-Level Authorization
findings.description: Authorization is role-level only. An admin can perform all operations with the same credential. No action-level granularity.
findings.gap: Cannot allow read but deny delete within admin scope.
findings.recommendation: Implement permission matrix with action-level checks.

findings.title: No Identity Propagation
findings.description: No JWT/OAuth token exchange, no on-behalf-of flows, no identity propagation capability. Cannot distinguish agent-as-self from agent-on-behalf-of-user.
findings.gap: No identity propagation or delegation mechanism.
findings.recommendation: Implement OAuth2 token exchange for on-behalf-of flows.

findings.title: Hardcoded Credential Fallbacks
findings.description: Database credentials have hardcoded fallback defaults in code. No secrets management system. No credential rotation.
findings.gap: Hardcoded 'ecommerce_pass' fallback. No AWS Secrets Manager or rotation.
findings.recommendation: Migrate credentials to AWS Secrets Manager with automatic rotation. Remove hardcoded fallbacks.

findings.title: No Agent Identity Suspension
findings.description: No mechanism to suspend an agent identity without deleting it. User management supports only CRUD — no disable/suspend flag.
findings.gap: Cannot revoke agent access without full deletion.
findings.recommendation: Add is_active field to users table with enforcement on every request.

findings.title: No Concurrency Controls
findings.description: No optimistic locking, no version fields, no ETags. Multiple concurrent agents could create race conditions on inventory and order status.
findings.gap: No concurrency controls for write operations.
findings.recommendation: Add version field to orders table with optimistic locking.

findings.title: No Rate Limiting
findings.description: WAF is IP whitelist only, not rate limiting. No application-level throttling. A whitelisted agent could make unlimited requests.
findings.gap: No rate limiting at any layer.
findings.recommendation: Add WAF rate-based rule and application-level throttling.

findings.title: No Transaction Limits
findings.description: No configurable limits on agent-initiated actions. Agent could approve unlimited returns, delete all users, or ship all orders without caps.
findings.gap: No per-caller business transaction limits.
findings.recommendation: Implement per-caller business limits (max refunds/hour, max deletions/day).

findings.title: No Configurable Approval Gates
findings.description: No configurable per-operation approval gates. High-risk operations (ship, delete user, approve refund) execute immediately when called.
findings.gap: No configurable approval requirement per operation type.
findings.recommendation: Implement configurable approval gates for high-risk operations.

findings.title: No Access Control Differentiation for Sensitive Data
findings.description: System stores customer PII and payment records. Passwords are excluded from API responses (B1 clear). However, no access control differentiation exists between sensitive and non-sensitive data (B2 fires). Binary admin/customer roles grant access to everything.
findings.gap: No differentiated access controls for sensitive vs non-sensitive data.
findings.recommendation: Implement OAuth scopes separating data domains (read:orders vs read:users vs read:payments).

findings.title: No PII Redaction in Logs
findings.description: No PII redaction mechanism. Exception messages (potentially containing user data) are logged and returned to clients. No log scrubbing or masking.
findings.gap: No PII redaction in error logs or error responses.
findings.recommendation: Sanitize error responses. Implement log scrubbing for PII fields.

findings.title: No Machine-Readable API Specification
findings.description: No OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, GraphQL schema, or Smithy model exists. ~25 REST endpoints defined only in PHP code.
findings.gap: No machine-readable API specification for agent tool generation.
findings.recommendation: Generate OpenAPI 3.0 specification documenting all endpoints.

findings.title: Minimal Structured Error Responses
findings.description: Error responses contain only an error message field with no error codes, retryable indicator, or field-level detail.
findings.gap: No structured error codes or retryable classification.
findings.recommendation: Implement structured error responses with codes and retryable boolean.

findings.title: No Pagination or Filtering
findings.description: List endpoints return all records with no pagination, filtering, or sorting. SELECT * without LIMIT.
findings.gap: Unbounded result sets on all list endpoints.
findings.recommendation: Add pagination parameters to all list endpoints.

findings.title: Minimal Input Validation
findings.description: Minimal validation (empty checks, prepared statements for injection protection). No schema enforcement, no validation framework, no field-level error responses.
findings.gap: No systematic input validation with structured error responses.
findings.recommendation: Implement request body validation with field-level error responses.

findings.title: No Timezone Normalization or Freshness Signaling
findings.description: Timestamps present (created_at, updated_at) but use server timezone without explicit UTC. No freshness headers in API responses.
findings.gap: No UTC standardization. No staleness signaling.
findings.recommendation: Standardize UTC storage. Add Last-Modified and Cache-Control headers.

findings.title: No Schema Versioning or API Contracts
findings.description: No API versioning, no schema files, no migration framework, no breaking change detection. Agent tool bindings break silently.
findings.gap: No versioning or contract testing for API stability.
findings.recommendation: Implement API versioning and schema management with breaking change detection.

findings.title: No Distributed Tracing or Structured Logging
findings.description: No OpenTelemetry, X-Ray, trace ID propagation, structured JSON logging, or correlation IDs.
findings.gap: Cannot debug agent-initiated requests through the system.
findings.recommendation: Implement X-Ray/OpenTelemetry with structured JSON logging and correlation IDs.

findings.title: No Alerting on Error Rates or Latency
findings.description: No CloudWatch alarms for application metrics. RDS Enhanced Monitoring exists but no alerting thresholds configured.
findings.gap: No alerts for agent API anomalies or degradation.
findings.recommendation: Add CloudWatch alarms for App Runner error rates and latency.

findings.title: Partial Infrastructure Governance
findings.description: CloudFormation IaC exists (comprehensive) but no CI/CD to enforce peer review and no drift detection configured.
findings.gap: IaC present (1/3 sub-checks). No peer review enforcement (2/3). No drift detection (3/3).
findings.recommendation: Add CI/CD pipeline with PR approval for IaC changes. Enable drift detection.

findings.title: No CI/CD Pipeline
findings.description: No CI/CD pipeline exists. Deployment is manual via deploy.sh script. No automated testing or contract validation.
findings.gap: No automated deployment pipeline or API contract testing.
findings.recommendation: Implement CI/CD pipeline with API contract testing.

findings.title: No Explicit Rollback Capability
findings.description: No blue/green deployment, no canary, no feature flags. Only App Runner health check failure provides basic protection.
findings.gap: No automated rollback for breaking API changes.
findings.recommendation: Implement blue/green deployment with rollback triggers.

findings.title: No API Test Coverage
findings.description: Zero automated tests. No test framework configured. No PHPUnit, no Postman collections, no integration tests.
findings.gap: No test coverage for any API endpoint.
findings.recommendation: Implement API test suite covering agent-facing endpoints.

findings.title: No Event Emission for State Changes
findings.description: State changes recorded in order_status_history DB table only. No webhooks, SNS/SQS/EventBridge, or event streaming.
findings.gap: No push-based notification for state changes.
findings.recommendation: Implement SNS/EventBridge for order status transitions.

findings.title: No Rate Limit Documentation or Headers
findings.description: No rate limit documentation, no X-RateLimit-Remaining or Retry-After headers. Agents cannot self-throttle.
findings.gap: No rate limit visibility for agent callers.
findings.recommendation: Document rate limits and add rate limit response headers.

findings.title: No Data Quality Monitoring
findings.description: No data quality metrics, profiling, or completeness monitoring for production data.
findings.gap: No quality metrics for data agents consume.
findings.recommendation: Implement data quality monitoring for critical fields.

findings.title: No Data Catalog or Metadata Layer
findings.description: No data catalog, metadata layer, or external schema documentation. Schema defined inline in PHP only.
findings.gap: No machine-readable data documentation.
findings.recommendation: Document schema in JSON Schema or data dictionary format.

findings.title: No Business Outcome Metrics
findings.description: No custom business metrics. Only infrastructure-level monitoring (RDS Enhanced Monitoring, VPC Flow Logs).
findings.gap: Cannot measure agent business impact.
findings.recommendation: Implement custom CloudWatch metrics for fulfillment rate, delivery time, return rate.

portfolio_level_findings.finding: No shared identity provider detected across portfolio repositories. Each service manages authentication independently with no centralized machine identity plane.
portfolio_level_findings.evidence: AUTH-Q1 is a BLOCKER in 11 of 15 services. No shared Cognito, Okta, or auth middleware referenced across repos.
portfolio_level_findings.recommendation: Deploy a centralized identity provider (Amazon Cognito or equivalent) serving all portfolio services with per-agent machine credentials.

portfolio_level_findings.finding: No shared trace ID propagation or centralized audit trail detected across the portfolio. Each service operates with independent (or absent) logging.
portfolio_level_findings.evidence: AUTH-Q6 (audit logging) is a BLOCKER in 11 services. OBS-Q1 (tracing) is a RISK-QUALITY finding in 15 services. No shared CloudTrail or correlation mechanism.
portfolio_level_findings.recommendation: Implement centralized audit trail with CloudTrail organization trail and shared trace ID propagation (X-Amzn-Trace-Id) across all services.

portfolio_level_findings.finding: No shared API gateway or WAF protecting the portfolio perimeter. Rate limiting is absent or configured independently per service.
portfolio_level_findings.evidence: STATE-Q5 (rate limiting) appears as a finding in 14 of 15 services. No shared WAF WebACL or portfolio-level API Gateway detected.
portfolio_level_findings.recommendation: Deploy shared WAF with rate-based rules at the portfolio perimeter. Configure per-agent usage plans across all agent-facing services.

portfolio_level_findings.finding: No explicit dependency_overrides provided and insufficient evidence in reports to infer inter-service dependencies. Transitive dependency analysis cannot be performed.
portfolio_level_findings.evidence: No dependency_overrides in portfolio config. No cross-service references detected in individual report findings.
portfolio_level_findings.recommendation: Add dependency_overrides to the portfolio configuration to enable transitive dependency safety analysis.

portfolio_level_findings.finding: No centralized mechanism to suspend or revoke agent identities across all services simultaneously. Each service manages agent identities independently.
portfolio_level_findings.evidence: AUTH-Q7 (agent identity suspension) is a RISK-SAFETY finding in 13 services. No portfolio-wide identity registry detected.
portfolio_level_findings.recommendation: Implement a centralized agent identity registry with portfolio-wide kill switch capability, integrated with the centralized identity provider (PORT-ARA-Q1).
